content.original: Asset Denial
content.prevOriginal: Asset Denial
content.content: Отказ от активов

content.original: All right, Commander, our goal is to track down the convoy...
content.prevOriginal: All right, Commander, our goal is to track down the convoy...
content.content: Итак, командир, наша цель - выследить этот конвой...

content.original: ...so let's scout out the target area. When we've found the convoy, we stop it from reaching its destination.
content.prevOriginal: ...so let's scout out the target area. When we've found the convoy, we stop it from reaching its destination.
content.content: ... что ж, давайте разведаем район. Когда обнаружим конвой, нужно будет не дать им добраться до места назначения.

content.original: Then we make our way to the evac zone.
content.prevOriginal: Then we make our way to the evac zone.
content.content: А после отправимся в зону эвакуации.

content.original: Get to it, Commander.
content.prevOriginal: Get to it, Commander.
content.content: За дело, командир.

content.original: Mission accomplished. The fire support vehicles have been neutralized.
content.prevOriginal: Mission accomplished. The fire support vehicles have been neutralized.
content.content: Миссия выполнена. Машины огневой поддержки нейтрализованы.

content.original: Nothing more to do here Commander, lets go home.
content.prevOriginal: Nothing more to do here Commander, lets go home.
content.content: Здесь больше нечего делать, командир, идём домой.

content.original: The target vehicles should be just ahead. Be careful commander, who knows what they're packing.
content.prevOriginal: The target vehicles should be just ahead. Be careful commander, who knows what they're packing.
content.content: Нужный нам транспорт должен быть прямо впереди. Будьте осторожны, командир, кто знает, с чем они там.

content.original: That's got it, primary target damaged. Keep on those ones.
content.prevOriginal: That's got it, primary target damaged. Keep on those ones.
content.content: Попадание, главная цель получила урон. Продолжайте бить по ним.

content.original: The guard units are dealt with; a wise move.
content.prevOriginal: The guard units are dealt with; a wise move.
content.content: С юнитами защиты разобрались; мудрый шаг.

content.original: Warning, Commander! The target vehicles have begun to arrive at their destination; not much time left before they escape!
content.prevOriginal: Warning, Commander! The target vehicles have begun to arrive at their destination; not much time left before they escape!
content.content: Внимание, командир! Целевой транспорт начал прибывать к месту назначения; осталось не так много времени до их отбытия!

content.original: One down. Keep engaging those threats and we'll be out of here.
content.prevOriginal: One down. Keep engaging those threats and we'll be out of here.
content.content: Один готов. Продолжайте давить и скоро мы все пойдём домой.

content.original: The convoy is finished, now get what 'mechs you have to the extraction point and we'll pull you out. Move quickly.
content.prevOriginal: The convoy is finished, now get what 'mechs you have to the extraction point and we'll pull you out. Move quickly.
content.content: С конвоем закончили, теперь ведите всех, кто остался, к точке эвакуации, и мы вас вытащим. Скорей.

content.original: We've got company!
content.prevOriginal: We've got company!
content.content: У нас гости!

content.original: Commander, the targets will probably be on the slow and squishy side. But the reason we're being asked to hit them in transit, outside entrenched positions, is because they pack a punch.
content.prevOriginal: Commander, the targets will probably be on the slow and squishy side. But the reason we're being asked to hit them in transit, outside entrenched positions, is because they pack a punch.
content.content: Командир, цели, вероятно, будут медленными и хлипкими. Но причина, по которой нас просят поразить их на подходе, вне укрепрайонов, заключается в том, что они несут мощное вооружение.

content.original: We maintain a very accurate registry of all military convoys on this planet. Recently, an analyst spotted something odd: a convoy that wasn't accounted for anywhere in our records. It's been regularly traveling along one of our standard logistical routes, and using our logistical comms, which is how it evaded detection for so long. Our signals intercepts tell us they're {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} drivers, so we have to assume they're smuggling right in our own backyard. We don't want to spook them with our own military comm chatter; we need an independent force to intercept and destroy them.
content.prevOriginal: We maintain a very accurate registry of all military convoys on this planet. It's been regularly traveling along one of our standard logistical routes, and using our logistical comms, which is how it evaded detection for so long. Our signals intercepts tell us they're {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} drivers, so we have to assume they're smuggling right in our own backyard. We don't want to spook them with our own military comm chatter; we need an independent force to intercept and destroy them.
content.content: Мы очень скрупулёзно ведём учет всего транспорта на нашей планете. Недавно один из аналитиков заметил нечто странное: целый конвой техники, которого не должно было быть по бумагам. Конвой регулярно перемещается по одному из наших стандартных логистических маршрутов и пользуется нашей частотой, что и позволило ему так долго оставаться незамеченным. Всё указывает на то, что это водители {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}, и, надо полагать, они занимаются контрабандой прямо у нас под носом. Мы не хотим спугнуть их переговорами по военной связи; нам нужен некто со стороны, чтобы перехватить и уничтожить их.

Мы полагаем, что злоумышленники действуют на секретном производственном объекте {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}, мы засекли передачи, указывающие на то, что они намерены перевезти свое недавно разработанное оружие в скрытый космопорт, а затем вывезти его за пределы планеты. content.original: Every month, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} sends out another supply convoy loaded with military hardware and valuable electronics. They guard it heavily, so we're not asking you to hit the main force; no sense in throwing away good mercenaries. Instead we want you to pick off the tail end of the convoy. The cargo isn't as valuable as what they send out in the vanguard, but it won't be as heavily defended. Take the convoy out, and we'll send in our people to grab whatever's still intact. We don't really want to get shot at, so we'll pay a bonus if you take out all the defenders, as well.
content.prevOriginal: Every month, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} sends out another supply convoy loaded with military hardware and valuable electronics. They guard it heavily, so we're not asking you to hit the main force; no sense in throwing away good mercenaries. Instead we want you to pick off the tail end of the convoy. The cargo isn't as valuable as what they send out in the vanguard, but it won't be as heavily defended. Take the convoy out, and we'll send in our people to grab whatever's still intact. We don't really want to get shot at, so we'll pay a bonus if you take out all the defenders, as well.
content.content: Каждый месяц {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} отправляет конвой, забитый под завязку военным оборудованием и электроникой. Его тщательно охраняют, поэтому мы не будем просить вступать с ними в бой; нет смысла разбрасываться хорошими наёмниками. Вместо этого мы хотим, чтобы вы отрезали хвост колонны. Груз в арьергарде не так ценен, как то, что они везут впереди, но он слабее защищен. Разбейте конвой и мы пришлем своих людей для сбора груза. Нам бы не хотелось, чтобы по нам стреляли, поэтому за полное уничтожение сил защиты мы заплатим сверх суммы контракта.

We believe the convoy is a shipment of weapons, including at least one intact Star League era weapon system. That could be an enormous payday for us. We want you to blow that convoy apart, and we'll pick through the remains.

Мы хотим, чтобы вы разнесли этот конвой на части, а мы соберем останки.

content.original: Somehow we've let {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} get their hands on one of our less reliable suppliers. It only took them a few days to break her, and now she's ready to spill all kinds of secrets in court. That isn't in our best interests, and since you're talking to us, it's not in yours, either. We'd like to do a little bit of witness tampering, of the fatal variety. She's being transported to a secure facility by ground vehicle. We don't know which vehicle she'll be in, so just take them all out. If you help us send a message by wiping out all the escorts, there's a bonus in it for you.

Мы бы хотели провести небольшую беседу со свидетелем, причем с летальным исходом. Ее везут в охраняемый объект на наземной технике. content.original: The target we'd like your people to eliminate is a notorious killer-for-hire who goes by the name 'The Professional'. They're currently under contract with {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}, and they've been spotted here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, which is extremely concerning for our interests. This mercenary is cagey and cautious and will attempt escape at any indication that they're overmatched. We'd like you to land a low-tonnage lance to engage them, to give them a false sense of security, and then eliminate them before they can escape. We're prepared to offer very generous salvage terms.

В настоящее время он работает по контракту с {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}, и его заметили здесь, на {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, что крайне опасно для наших дел. Этот наёмник очень осторожен и попытается сбежать при первом признаке угрозы. Мы хотели бы, чтобы вы отправили туда легковесный отряд, чтобы вызвать у него ложное чувство безопасности, а затем уничтожили до того, как он сможет сбежать. Мы готовы предложить очень щедрые условия раздела трофеев.

Основываясь на отчетах ведущих аналитиков {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}, мы полагаем, что в этом районе находится пропагандистка {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}, разжигающая недовольства. Мы расставили людей и установили охранную сеть, чтобы поймать её. Но мы не можем перекрыть все возможные выходы из сети, и нам не помешает дополнительный отряд мехов. Если она попытается проскользнуть через отведенную вам территорию, превратите её отряд в дуршлаг.

content.original: Our spies report that a veteran {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} MechWarrior from the Succession Wars retired to this system, and {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} would very much like to keep him retired. Permanently if possible. We've been monitoring a DropShip in orbit around the planet, and believe that they're preparing for a pickup. We need you to drop and intercept this MechWarrior before he can be reactivated. He's likely in a fairly heavy 'Mech, so be careful when you engage him.

We need you to drop and intercept this MechWarrior before he can be reactivated. He's likely in a fairly heavy 'Mech, so be careful when you engage him.

До самой его смерти, если возможно. Мы отслеживаем дропшип на орбите планеты и полагаем, что тот готовится подобрать мехвоина. Нам нужно, чтобы вы отправились туда и перехватили этого мехвоина до того, как тот заступит на службу. Скорее всего, у него довольно тяжёлый мех, так что будьте осторожны при столкновении с ним.

A MechWarrior stationed there murdered the rest of the staff and is defecting to {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}, taking a valuable {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 'Mech with her. The facility is a total loss, but we don't want that 'Mech falling into enemy hands. Track down the renegade and destroy her 'Mech. content.original: We've learned that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have constructed a forward base on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, ignoring the express wishes of the local government. Naturally, the planetary governor is furious, but he can't make a stand against {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} BattleMechs without assistance; {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} has offered that assistance. You are to seize control of the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} base and hold it until we gain a legal claim to the facility. We will then sell it back to the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} government at a considerable discount.

content.original: Fifteen years ago we lost track of a facility here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, and {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} intelligence believed it had been permanently shut down. A month ago, an orbiting spy satellite picked up signs that the facility had been brought back online. Our current guess is that a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} team was dispatched to bring the base back up to operational capacity. We'd rather not have sensitive radar backed by armed turrets and flak batteries aimed at the skies of {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. We'd like you to clear their team out and hold the facility while our own people land to scour it for useful intel.

content.original: We've learned that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} here in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} has been busy working on a new water filtration technology, which is both extremely valuable and likely to shift the balance of power in the region by opening up more worlds for colonization. We've discovered where they're working on the latest prototype. We know that they are monitoring the location of our own 'Mechs in the area, so we need a mercenary lance to make the vanguard assault and catch them by surprise. content.original: We've got a developing situation, Commander, and we need immediate aid from a reliable mercenary company. A covert {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} team was investigating reports of a cache of bioweapons on an otherwise abandoned world. We've tracked down four of these caches in the Periphery over the last 20 years, and disposed of them safely. The team was about to signal for an extraction when their signal went dead. We have reason to believe that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have taken control of the cache site, and eliminated our covert team. We need you to take that site and signal our disposal team.
content.prevOriginal: We've got a developing situation, Commander, and we need immediate aid from a reliable mercenary company. We've tracked down four of these caches in the Periphery over the last 20 years, and disposed of them safely. The team was about to signal for an extraction when their signal went dead. We have reason to believe that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have taken control of the cache site, and eliminated our covert team. We need you to take that site and signal our disposal team.
content.content: У нас складывается ситуация, командир, и нам нужна немедленная помощь надежной компании наёмников. Группа наших тайных агентов расследовала сообщения о тайнике с биооружием на заброшенном мире. За последние 20 лет мы отследили четыре таких тайника на Периферии и благополучно ликвидировали их. Команда уже собиралась подать сигнал об эвакуации, когда их сигнал заглох. У нас есть основания полагать, что силы {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} захватили контроль над тайником и уничтожили наших агентов. Нам нужно, чтобы вы захватили это место, а после - вызвали нашу группу утилизации.

content.original: We're training a group of MechWarriors to act as a local defense force, and we'd like you to assist in their training. There's a decommissioned {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} base that we need to take ownership of. As it's undefended, this is a perfect opportunity for our trainees to practice operating as a team in a low-risk environment. We need you to send along a single experienced MechWarrior to keep an eye on them and model good behavior for them.
content.prevOriginal: We're training a group of MechWarriors to act as a local defense force, and we'd like you to assist in their training. We need you to send along a single experienced MechWarrior to keep an eye on them and model good behavior for them.
content.content: Мы обучаем группу мехвоинов, которая будет действовать в качестве местных сил обороны, и мы хотели бы, чтобы вы помогли в их обучении. Есть одна списанная база {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}, которую нужно взять под свой контроль. Поскольку она не защищена, это прекрасная возможность для наших стажеров потренироваться действовать в команде в условиях низкого риска. Нам нужно, чтобы вы прислали одного опытного мехвоина, чтобы тот присматривал за ними и был для них примером.

Unfortunately, the colonial plan fell through, and we now have to extract our people from the planet's surface before they're intercepted by hostile forces. As the colony was a secret, thanks to the conflicting and dubious claims on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}, we cannot be seen to mount a major rescue operation. We need a deniable middle-man.

We don't have an in-system military presence large enough to mount a hostage rescue mission, so we're looking for a competent mercenary company to do it. We need you to reach the facility where the crew is being held, destroy the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units guarding them, and escort them to safety.

content.original: Hostile {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have been making increasingly bold incursions toward one of our processing facilities on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. This facility represents a substantial cash investment for {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}, and its destruction would be both politically and financially disastrous. We need a capable mercenary company to defend the site. Payment will be remitted upon the repulsion of all hostile {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units.
content.prevOriginal: Hostile {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have been making increasingly bold incursions toward one of our processing facilities on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. We need a capable mercenary company to defend the site. Payment will be remitted upon the repulsion of all hostile {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units.
content.content: Вражеские силы {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} совершают всё более и более дерзкие вылазки в сторону одного из наших перерабатывающих предприятий на {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} вложили в этот объект значительные денежные инвестиции, и его уничтожение будет иметь как политические, так и финансовые последствия. Нам нужна компетентная группа наёмников для защиты объекта. Оплата будет произведена после того, как все враждебные юниты {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} будут отброшены.

content.original: A few hours ago, some enterprising lads from our organization planetside were able to seize control of a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} research facility. They maybe hadn't thought their entire plan through, so right now there's a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} strike force on the way to level the base before our boys can download any valuable data. We need you to cover them while they finish up and escape.

content.original: Somehow, the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} authorities have discovered one of our storehouses. If it were just drugs or stolen goods, we'd let them seize it and write it off as a loss. But it's a weapons stockpile, and those damn things are hard to move from one system to another. We'd like you to protect our guns while our people load them onto transports and we evacuate them.
content.prevOriginal: Somehow, the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} authorities have discovered one of our storehouses. If it were just drugs or stolen goods, we'd let them seize it and write it off as a loss. But it's a weapons stockpile, and those damn things are hard to move from one system to another. We'd like you to protect our guns while our people load them onto transports and we evacuate them.
content.content: Каким-то образом власти {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} обнаружили один из наших складов. Если бы это были просто наркотики или краденые товары, мы бы позволили им их конфисковать и списали как убытки. Но это склад оружия, и эти чёртовы штуки трудно переместить из одной системы в другую. Мы бы хотели, чтобы вы охраняли наши пушки, пока наши люди будут грузить их на транспорты и вывозить с планеты.

content.original: That could also explain the satellite failures. Okay, people, don't answer any calls from outside our secure comms.

content.prevOriginal: Commander, Darius: if I'm right, that base will need to be completely destroyed.
content.content: Командир. Насколько я понимаю, базу нужно уничтожить полностью.

content.original: Acknowledged, Dr. Murad. Commander, once you've dealt with the base, Meyer will be on station to pick you up at this LZ.
content.prevOriginal: Acknowledged, Dr. Murad. Commander, once you've dealt with the base, Meyer will be on station to pick you up at this LZ.
content.content: Принято, доктор Мурад. Командир, как только вы разберетесь с базой, Мейер будет на месте и заберет вас с этой базы.

content.original: I wonder if {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} intended this to happen, or if they were themselves infected?
content.prevOriginal: I wonder if {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} intended this to happen, or if they were themselves infected?
content.content: Мне вот интересно, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} хотели, чтобы это произошло, и не заразились ли они сами?

content.original: As long as we've wiped out all traces of that signal, I'm not sure I care.
content.prevOriginal: As long as we've wiped out all traces of that signal, I'm not sure I care.
content.content: Если мы сотрем все следы этого сигнала, то мне все равно.

content.original: I'd be quite surprised if we never saw that signal again, Darius. It's like bedbugs: the sort of thing that you never quite eradicate.
content.prevOriginal: I'd be quite surprised if we never saw that signal again, Darius. It's like bedbugs: the sort of thing that you never quite eradicate.

content.original: We've just lost contact with one of our facilities, Commander, and we need your help. Earlier today, our facility here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} received what they believed was a normal data transmission. It was badly garbled, and when they requested it be re-sent, they got no response. Shortly thereafter the base systems began to malfunction, and then we lost contact with both the base and the synchronous satellites covering that region. We'd like you to investigate the facility.

content.content: Мы только что потеряли связь с одним из наших объектов, командир, и нам нужна ваша помощь. Она была сильно искажена, и когда они запросили ее повторную отправку, то не получили ответа. И вскоре после этого системы базы начали сбоить, а затем мы потеряли связь и с базой, и с передающими спутниками, покрывающими этот регион. Мы бы хотели, чтобы вы проверили объект.

content.original: We are looking for a mercenary company to do some covert work for us. We've lost a base to {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}, and believe {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} personnel are being interrogated even now. We can't allow those people to spill their secrets, but it would look bad if we were seen to destroy our own base. We need deniability. We need you to level the base, particularly the storage and communications facilities. We'd appreciate it if you ensured there were no living witnesses, and will pay a bonus if you wipe out all the opposition.

Мы потеряли базу {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}, и полагаем, что персонал {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} прямо сейчас допрашивают. Мы не можем позволить тем людям выдать наши секреты, но будет плохо выглядеть, если нас увидят за уничтожением собственной базы. Наша непричастность должна быть неоспорима. Нам нужно, чтобы вы сравняли базу с землей, особенно хранилища и средства связи. Мы будем благодарны, если вы позаботитесь о том, чтобы не осталось живых свидетелей, и заплатим премию, если вы уничтожите всю оппозицию.

content.original: Commander, we perform a substantial amount of scientific research here in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}. {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have been sabotaging our research stations, stretching our defenses thin. We've just learned that their ultimate target is a key scientist in our weapons development program. They've launched an assault that we believe is intended to capture her. We need you to reach the facility where she's stationed and extract her to safety.

We need you to reach the facility where she's stationed and extract her to safety.
content.content: На планете {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} проводится значительное число наших научных исследований. К сожалению, из-за постоянных нападений и саботажа со стороны {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} наша защита сильно ослабла. Разведка недавно выяснила, что настоящей целью нападений является одна из ведущих учёных, задействованных в одном из проектов по разработке оружия. Также нам стало известно, что противник собирается начать штурм лаборатории, в которой она работает, с целью её захвата. Необходимо, чтобы ваш отряд высадился в данном районе как можно скорее и эвакуировал её в безопасное место.

content.original: We've discovered a facility where {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} researchers have developed a new computer virus that targets the control mechanisms of our 'Mechs. We can't build an effective defense against this virus without a sample of its code to work with. We need you to get one of your 'Mechs within range of the research facility and download the virus into its systems. Then extract the infected carrier 'Mech so we can analyze the virus.

Мы не сможем создать эффективную защиту от этого вируса без образца его кода, с которым можно работать. Нам нужно, чтобы вы доставили один из ваших мехов в радиус действия исследовательского центра и загрузили вирус в свои системы. Затем доставьте зараженный мех нам, чтобы мы смогли изучить вирус.

She was privy to numerous industrial secrets that we would prefer not to fall into our competitor's hands. Руководство {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} предложило деньги за её возвращение, но мы намерены использовать ложные переговоры, чтобы выиграть для вас время перевезти учёного в безопасное место.

content.original: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} philanthropist is a patron of the arts here in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}. A favored painter has been accused of heresy by the system's religious police. These zealots are propped up by foreign {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} agents. He'll be extradited to face trial and likely execution in {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} territory. We can't allow that to happen, but we don't want to incur reprisal from the religious leaders. That's where you come in. Locate the painter, rescue him and, at the personal request of the patron, recover the painting that started this whole mess.

content.original: We have an opportunity to get our hands on the next season of a popular holovid series before it's sent out for general distribution. Fans will pay through the nose to get a copy even a few weeks early. All you have to do is go to the secure {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} facility where the data is being stored, and our agent will transmit the data directly to your 'Mech. content.original: We have an operation planned to raid a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} logistical base, steal everything that isn't nailed down, and sell it on the black market. There's a missing element in the plan: you. We need you to draw off a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} patrol so that we can move into the base unopposed and load the goods. We figure that you hit the patrol, they call for reinforcements, and then you take those out as well. Then, we sell the stuff and split the take with you.

В нашем плане не хватает только одного элемента: вас. Нам нужно, чтобы вы отвлекли патруль {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}, чтобы мы смогли беспрепятственно проникнуть на базу и загрузить товар. Мы предполагаем, что вы ударите по патрулю, они вызовут подкрепление, и вы ударите и по нему. Затем мы продадим товар и поделим с вами выручку.

content.original: We've been offering our good friends, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}, the opportunity to buy an insurance policy on their 'Mechs. I mean, they're big, complicated pieces of machinery, right? And hardly anyone knows how to fix them? So we're offering to insure them just in case something accidental happens to them. Would you believe they said 'no thanks'? It was a really good offer. We want to show them just how good. We'd like you to cause something accidental to happen to their 'Mechs.

Мы хотим показать им, насколько сильно они прогадали. Устройте с их мехами что-нибудь трагически случайное.

content.original: We've got an interesting opportunity for you, Commander. We've recently detected a major engine signature on the planet, probably an assault-class 'Mech. We can't have an assault-class {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 'Mech that big wandering around loose, and we'd like you to handle it. The interesting part is that we've also detected another assault power-up, and it's a different 'Mech entirely, and it's closing with the target. It's possible you can just swoop in and pick up the pieces. We're prepared to offer generous salvage terms.
content.prevOriginal: We've got an interesting opportunity for you, Commander. We've recently detected a major engine signature on the planet, probably an assault-class 'Mech. We can't have an assault-class {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 'Mech that big wandering around loose, and we'd like you to handle it. The interesting part is that we've also detected another assault power-up, and it's a different 'Mech entirely, and it's closing with the target. It's possible you can just swoop in and pick up the pieces. We're prepared to offer generous salvage terms.
content.content: У нас есть для вас интересное предложение, командир. Недавно мы зафиксировали на планете сигнатуру крупного двигателя, вероятно, меха штурмового класса. Мы не можем допустить, чтобы такой большой мех {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} разгуливал просто так, и мы хотели бы, чтобы вы им занялись. Самое интересное, что мы обнаружили ещё одну сигнатуру штурмового класса, и это совсем другой мех, и он приближается к первой цели. Возможно, вы сможете просто прилететь и забрать куски, что от них останутся. Мы готовы предложить щедрые условия раздела.

content.prevOriginal: There are additional DropShips inbound. Hopefully we can keep them off of our allies.

content.prevOriginal: Good luck, Commander.

content.original: Success! Our Employer will be happy.
content.prevOriginal: Success! Our Employer will be happy.
content.content: Успех! Наш наниматель будет счастлив.

content.prevOriginal: Let's wrap this up.

content.original: INCOMING MESSAGE.

content.prevOriginal: Copy that, we have eyes on the targets.

content.original: Thanks.
content.prevOriginal: Thanks.

content.prevOriginal: We are counting on you.

content.prevOriginal: Another member of our ally's Lance just went down! Looks like they managed to eject, but we can't risk this happening again!
content.content: Ещё один из союзников пал! Похоже, ему удалось катапультироваться, но другим может так не повезти, если это повторится.

content.original: She's right, Commander. This mission is over if our friends go down. I suggest that you protect what's left of our ally's Lance at all costs.
content.prevOriginal: She's right, Commander. This mission is over if our friends go down. I suggest that you protect what's left of our ally's Lance at all costs.
content.content: Она права, командир. Миссии конец, если наши друзья погибнут. Я предлагаю вам любой ценой защищать то, что осталось от отряда союзников.

content.original: We've got 'Mechs on the ground, Commander. Ready to advance on the enemy when you are.
content.prevOriginal: We've got 'Mechs on the ground, Commander. Ready to advance on the enemy when you are.
content.content: Наши мехи на земле, командир. Готовы к наступлению на врага, по вашей готовности.

content.original: Looks like we have some unexpected support from other forces. This is the Secondary version.
content.prevOriginal: PLACEHOLDER  Looks like we have some unexpected support from other forces. This is the Secondary version.
content.content: Похоже, мы получили неожиданную поддержку со стороны. Они - второстепенная цель.

content.original: Glad we could make it to the party, Commander. Our orders are to assist in the Primary Objective and once eliminated head for Evac.
content.prevOriginal: PLACEHOLDER  Glad we could make it to the party, Commander. Our orders are to assist in the Primary Objective and once eliminated head for Evac.
content.content: Рад, что мы смогли попасть на вечеринку. Наш приказ - оказать содействие в выполнении основной задачи и, как только она будет выполнена, эвакуироваться.

content.original: Copy that Lance Leader.
content.prevOriginal: PLACEHOLDER  Copy that Lance Leader.
content.content: Лидер отряда, вас понял.

content.original: We just lost a member of our Ally's Lance, Commander. I'm marking their ejection pod for post-mission recovery.
content.prevOriginal: We just lost a member of our Ally's Lance, Commander. I'm marking their ejection pod for post-mission recovery.
content.content: Мы только что потеряли одного из отряда союзников, командир. Я отмечу упавшую капсулу для будущей эвакуации, после миссии.

content.prevOriginal: PLACEHOLDER The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} has been destroyed.
content.content: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} были уничтожены.

content.original: Commander, we've got a priority target for you. An elite {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance has just been spotted by our orbital surveillance, out in the open and without any local support. What's more, they've got significant damage from a previous battle. This is an opportunity for us to severely weaken opposition forces on this planet, but we have no forces in range to make the strike. We need you to engage and destroy this lance.
content.prevOriginal: Commander, we've got a priority target for you. An elite {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance has just been spotted by our orbital surveillance, out in the open and without any local support. What's more, they've got significant damage from a previous battle. This is an opportunity for us to severely weaken opposition forces on this planet, but we have no forces in range to make the strike. We need you to engage and destroy this lance.
content.content: Командир, у нас есть для вас приоритетная цель. Элитное копьё {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} только что было обнаружено нашей орбитальной разведкой, они движутся по открытке, не прячась и похоже без какой-либо поддержки. Более того, они получили значительный урон от предыдущей битвы. Это возможность для нас серьезно ослабить силы противника на этой планете, но у нас нет поблизости достаточных сил, чтобы нанести удар. Нам нужно, чтобы вы вступили в бой и уничтожили это копье.

content.original: Our people took a beating in a recent engagement, Commander, and we lost an entire lance. One of our pilots was killed when their 'Mech fell over, and the last of the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} survivors was able to get our 'Mech back on its feet. Now they're hoping to get it safely to their dropship and claim it for their own. We need you to stop their salvage attempt, and bring that 'Mech down. It's still an active battlefield down there, so no telling what you'll encounter.
content.prevOriginal: Our people took a beating in a recent engagement, Commander, and we lost an entire lance. One of our pilots was killed when their 'Mech fell over, and the last of the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} survivors was able to get our 'Mech back on its feet. Now they're hoping to get it safely to their dropship and claim it for their own. We need you to stop their salvage attempt, and bring that 'Mech down. It's still an active battlefield down there, so no telling what you'll encounter.
content.content: Наши люди пострадали в недавнем бою, командир, мы потеряли целый отряд. Один из наших пилотов погиб, когда его мех упал. Последний из выживших смог поднять наш мех на ноги. Теперь он надеется доставить его на их дропшип и забрать его себе. Нам нужно, чтобы вы пресекли эту попытку кражи и уничтожили этот мех. Там всё ещё идут активные боевые действия, поэтому неизвестно, с чем вы столкнетесь.

Это идеальное время для нанесения удара, поскольку они, скорее всего, повреждены и измотаны учениями, и мы полагаем, что они не догадываются о нашем присутствии. Неясно, кто ещё участвует в учениях, но кто бы это ни был, он - потенциальный свидетель, поэтому нам нужно, чтобы вы устранили и его.

content.original: We have a developing situation, Commander, and we need your help to resolve it. One of our minor signals outposts on the planet was attacked and destroyed recently by a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} force, and they're now moving in the open towards a supply depot that we cannot afford to lose. We'd like your team to set down and intercept them; they're very heavily armed, but they're making no real effort to conceal their movement. They should be a relatively simple target.
content.prevOriginal: We have a developing situation, Commander, and we need your help to resolve it. One of our minor signals outposts on the planet was attacked and destroyed recently by a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} force, and they're now moving in the open towards a supply depot that we cannot afford to lose. We'd like your team to set down and intercept them; they're very heavily armed, but they're making no real effort to conceal their movement. They should be a relatively simple target.
content.content: У нас здесь складывается ситуация, командир, и нам нужна ваша помощь в её разрешении. Один из наших небольших сигнальных форпостов на планете недавно был атакован и уничтожен силами {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}, и сейчас они движутся в открытую к складу снабжения, который мы не можем позволить себе потерять. Мы хотели бы, чтобы ваша команда высадилась и перехватила их; они очень хорошо вооружены и не предпринимают никаких усилий, чтобы скрыть своё передвижение. Они должны быть сравнительно лёгкой мишенью.

content.original: A mid-level {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} official has decided to personally patrol a moderately dangerous region of the planet. We've done our best to dissuade her, but she's insistent that she show the people she's willing to take risks on their behalf. Rather than let her stumble around in her family's ancestral Griffin until some opportunistic pirate decides to murder her, we'd like for you to escort her and keep her alive.
content.prevOriginal: A mid-level {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} official has decided to personally patrol a moderately dangerous region of the planet. We've done our best to dissuade her, but she's insistent that she show the people she's willing to take risks on their behalf. Rather than let her stumble around in her family's ancestral Griffin until some opportunistic pirate decides to murder her, we'd like for you to escort her and keep her alive.
content.content: Чиновник среднего звена {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} решила лично патрулировать умеренно опасный регион планеты. Мы сделали всё возможное, чтобы отговорить ее, но она настойчиво хочет показать людям, что готова пойти на риск ради них. Вместо того чтобы позволить ей разгуливать в своем фамильном «Гриффине», пока какой-нибудь беспринципный пират не решит ее убить, мы бы хотели, чтобы вы сопровождали ее и сохранили ей жизнь.

content.original: I suspect this will be a waste of your time, Commander. I'm perfectly capable of taking care of myself.
content.prevOriginal: I suspect this will be a waste of your time, Commander. I'm perfectly capable of taking care of myself.

content.original: We're being paid to accompany you. If there's no fighting, we got paid to stretch our legs and take in the sights.
content.prevOriginal: We're being paid to accompany you. If there's no fighting, we got paid to stretch our legs and take in the sights.
content.content: Нам платят за то, чтобы мы сопровождали вас. Если нет драки, то нам заплатят за то, чтобы мы размяли ноги, да посмотрели достопримечательности.

content.original: ... In that case, Commander, we're weapons-hot. Keep that VIP alive.
content.prevOriginal: ... In that case, Commander, we're weapons-hot. Keep that VIP alive.
content.content: ... В таком случае, командир, наше оружие разогрето. Держите этого VIP в живых.

content.prevOriginal: I'm listening, you know. Don't talk about me like I'm not even here!

content.original: When it's time to evac, Commander, I'll pick you up here.

content.original: A mid-level {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} official has decided to personally patrol a moderately dangerous region of the planet. We've done our best to dissuade her, but she's insistent that she show the people she's willing to take risks on their behalf. Rather than let her stumble around in her family's ancestral mech until some opportunistic pirate decides to murder her, we'd like for you to escort her and keep her alive.

Rather than let her stumble around in her family's ancestral Griffin until some opportunistic pirate decides to murder her, we'd like for you to escort her and keep her alive.
content.content: Чиновник среднего звена {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} решила лично патрулировать умеренно опасный регион планеты. Мы сделали всё возможное, чтобы отговорить ее, но она настойчиво хочет показать людям, что готова пойти на риск ради них. Вместо того чтобы позволить ей разгуливать в своем фамильном мехе, пока какой-нибудь беспринципный пират не решит ее убить, мы бы хотели, чтобы вы сопровождали ее и сохранили ей жизнь.

content.original: Commander, we've been tracking a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance moving through a contested area on the planet's surface. A few hours ago, our scouts reported another lance, of unknown allegiance, on an interception course. We suspect a fight is brewing, and we'd like you to act as a spoiler. Eliminate the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance, and the unknown ambushers as well. We don't want to leave any witnesses.

Несколько часов назад разведка сообщила о ещё одном копье от неизвестной фракции, они идут на перехват первому. Мы подозреваем, что назревает драка и мы хотели бы, чтобы вы вмешались и уничтожили и копьё {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} и неизвестных перехватчиков. Нам не нужны свидетели.

content.original: We have a situation here and we'd like your help. We've detected a joint task force of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} and {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} units operating openly on the planet. We need to hunt them down and turn them to scrap, but even if we do manage to find them, our own forces aren't up to the task of engaging that many enemies at once. We'd like you to send a lance to accompany our own team; the two of you can then engage the enemy together and negate their numerical advantage.
content.prevOriginal: We have a situation here and we'd like your help. We've detected a joint task force of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} and {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} units operating openly on the planet. We need to hunt them down and turn them to scrap, but even if we do manage to find them, our own forces aren't up to the task of engaging that many enemies at once. We'd like you to send a lance to accompany our own team; the two of you can then engage the enemy together and negate their numerical advantage.
content.content: У нас возникла непростая ситуация, и нам нужна ваша помощь. Мы обнаружили совместную оперативную группу из {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} и {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Name}, открыто действующую на планете. Нужно выследить их и сдать на металлолом, но даже если мы их настигнем, наши силы не смогут справиться с таким количеством врагов. Мы хотели бы, чтобы вы отправили свой отряд в помощь нашей команде; тогда вдвоём вы сможете сразиться с врагом и свести на нет его численное преимущество.

content.original: We have a situation here and we'd like your help. We've detected a joint task force of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} and {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} units operating openly on the planet. We need to hunt them down and turn them to scrap, but even if we do manage to find them, our own forces aren't up to the task of engaging that many enemies at once. We'd like you to send a lance to accompany our own team; the two of you can then engage the enemy together and negate their numerical advantage.
content.prevOriginal: We have a situation here and we'd like your help. We've detected a joint task force of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} and {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} units operating openly on the planet. We need to hunt them down and turn them to scrap, but even if we do manage to find them, our own forces aren't up to the task of engaging that many enemies at once. We'd like you to send a lance to accompany our own team; the two of you can then engage the enemy together and negate their numerical advantage.
content.content: У нас возникла непростая ситуация, и нам нужна ваша помощь. Мы обнаружили совместную оперативную группу из {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} и {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Name}, открыто действующую на планете. Нужно выследить их и сдать на металлолом, но даже если мы их настигнем, наши силы не смогут справиться с таким количеством врагов. Мы хотели бы, чтобы вы отправили свой отряд в помощь нашей команде; тогда вдвоём вы сможете сразиться с врагом и свести на нет его численное преимущество.

content.original: We've captured the latest pride and joy of the Capellan Confederation: a Cataphract CTF-IM. Our scientists have been reverse-engineering the monster, but now they say they need real battle data before they can continue. We'd like you to provide that data. We've located a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance to use as a guinea pig. Take the CTF-IM down to the planet and eliminate that lance. Needless to say, we don't have another of these, so it's imperative that you return it intact.
content.prevOriginal: We've captured the latest pride and joy of the Capellan Confederation: a Cataphract CTF-IM. Our scientists have been reverse-engineering the monster, but now they say they need real battle data before they can continue. We'd like you to provide that data. We've located a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance to use as a guinea pig. Take the CTF-IM down to the planet and eliminate that lance. Needless to say, we don't have another of these, so it's imperative that you return it intact.
content.content: Мы захватили последнюю гордость и радость Капелланской Конфедерации: Cataphract CTF-IM. Наши ученые занимались реинжинирингом этого монстра, но теперь они говорят, что им нужны реальные данные с боя, прежде чем они смогут продолжить. Мы хотели бы, чтобы вы предоставили им эти данные. Мы нашли отряд {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}, чтобы использовать его в качестве подопытного кролика. Отправляйтесь на CTF-IM на планету и уничтожьте этот отряд. Само собой, другого такого меха у нас нет, поэтому крайне важно, чтобы вы вернули его в целости и сохранности.

content.original: We've captured a rare {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} mech. Our scientists have been reverse-engineering it, but now they say they need real battle data before they can continue. We'd like you to provide that data. We've located a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance to use as a guinea pig. Take the mech down to the planet and eliminate that lance. Needless to say, we don't have another of these, so it's imperative that you return it intact.

Мы бы хотели, чтобы вы предоставили эти данные. Мы обнаружили отряд {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}, они сгодятся в качестве подопытного кролика. Отправьтесь с мехом на планету и уничтожьте этот отряд. Нет нужды говорить, что у нас нет другого такого, поэтому крайне важно, чтобы вы вернули его в целости и сохранности.

content.original: We've captured a rare {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} mech. Our scientists have been reverse-engineering it, but now they say they need real battle data before they can continue. We'd like you to provide that data. We've located a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance to use as a guinea pig. Take the mech down to the planet and eliminate that lance. Needless to say, we don't have another of these, so it's imperative that you return it intact.
content.prevOriginal: We've captured a rare {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} mech. Our scientists have been reverse-engineering it, but now they say they need real battle data before they can continue. We'd like you to provide that data. We've located a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance to use as a guinea pig. Take the mech down to the planet and eliminate that lance. Needless to say, we don't have another of these, so it's imperative that you return it intact.
content.content: Мы захватили редкий мех {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Name}. Наши ученые занимались его реинжинирингом, но сейчас им нужны реальные боевые данные, прежде чем они смогут продолжить. Мы бы хотели, чтобы вы предоставили эти данные. Мы обнаружили отряд {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}, они сгодятся в качестве подопытного кролика. Отправьтесь с мехом на планету и уничтожьте этот отряд. Нет нужды говорить, что у нас нет другого такого, поэтому крайне важно, чтобы вы вернули его в целости и сохранности.

content.original: Commander, that is the ugliest damn 'Mech I've ever seen. Built like a brick shithouse, though.
content.prevOriginal: Commander, that is the ugliest damn 'Mech I've ever seen. Built like a brick shithouse, though.
content.content: Командир, это самый уродливый мех, что я когда-либо видел. Хотя его хрен пробьёшь.

content.original: Stow it, Yang. We're tracking the target lance in this region, Commander. Move up and put this thing through its paces.

content.content: Погоди, Ян. Командир, мы засекли нужный нам отряд в этом регионе. Выдвигайтесь и проверьте их там на прочность.

content.original: When you're ready to evac, Commander, I'll pick you up here.
content.prevOriginal: When you're ready to evac, Commander, I'll pick you up here.
content.content: Когда вы будете готовы к эвакуации, командир, я подберу вас здесь.

content.prevOriginal: I hope that was enough data for the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} scientists.

content.original: We've captured a rare {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} mech. Our scientists have been reverse-engineering it, but now they say they need real battle data before they can continue. We'd like you to provide that data. We've located a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance to use as a guinea pig. Take the mech down to the planet and eliminate that lance. Needless to say, we don't have another of these, so it's imperative that you return it intact.

Мы бы хотели, чтобы вы предоставили эти данные. Мы обнаружили отряд {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}, они сгодятся в качестве подопытного кролика. Отправьтесь с мехом на планету и уничтожьте этот отряд. Нет нужды говорить, что у нас нет другого такого, поэтому крайне важно, чтобы вы вернули его в целости и сохранности.

content.original: Commander, we're planning a joint patrol operation with our allies in a dangerous region of the planet. We're expecting trouble, but these joint exercises are part of a larger diplomatic effort and it's critical that they succeed. We'd like you to provide some additional firepower to ensure that both our lance and our allied lance complete the patrol and evac intact. We're expecting major enemy resistance so plan for a heavy drop.
content.prevOriginal: Commander, we're planning a joint patrol operation with our allies in a dangerous region of the planet. We're expecting trouble, but these joint exercises are part of a larger diplomatic effort and it's critical that they succeed. We'd like you to provide some additional firepower to ensure that both our lance and our allied lance complete the patrol and evac intact. We're expecting major enemy resistance so plan for a heavy drop.
content.content: Командующий {COMMANDER.LastName}, мы планируем провести совместное учебное патрулирование с нашими союзниками в опасном регионе планеты. Несмотря на ожидаемые столкновения, данные учения являются частью дипломатических мер, направленных на улучшения наших отношений с союзниками. И нам крайне важно, чтобы они прошли успешно. Для того, чтобы уменьшить возможное количество несчастных случаев во время этих учений, мы усиляем патруль силами наёмников. В зоне операции ожидается сильное сопротивление противника, так что рекомендуем подготовить тяжёлую технику.

content.original: We're trying to build a local defense force of MechWarriors here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. Our pilots are inexperienced and untested, and we'd like you to help us train them. We've picked up a troubling signal which may represent hostile activity, which seems like a good opportunity to send our new defense force out to handle it. Can you bring along an experienced MechWarrior and 'Mech to keep them out of trouble?
content.prevOriginal: We're trying to build a local defense force of MechWarriors here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. Our pilots are inexperienced and untested, and we'd like you to help us train them. We've picked up a troubling signal which may represent hostile activity, which seems like a good opportunity to send our new defense force out to handle it. Can you bring along an experienced MechWarrior and 'Mech to keep them out of trouble?
content.content: Мы пытаемся создать местные силы обороны из мехвоинов здесь, на {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. Наши пилоты не имеют опыта, и мы бы хотели, чтобы вы помогли нам обучить их. Мы засекли тревожный сигнал, который может означать враждебную активность, что кажется хорошей возможностью закалить наших воинов. Если можно, пришлите одного опытного мехвоина и мех, чтобы уберечь их от неприятностей.

content.original: Training Day
content.prevOriginal: Training Day
content.content: Учебный день

content.original: Oh gosh, I'm really excited about this. I hope we see some fighting!
content.prevOriginal: Oh gosh, I'm really excited about this. I hope we see some fighting!
content.content: О боже ты мой, я реально волнуюсь. Надеюсь, нам доведется поучаствовать в боях!

content.original: I- I'm not sure. We didn't do very well at the practice range.
content.prevOriginal: I- I'm not sure. We didn't do very well at the practice range.
content.content: Ну... не знаю. Мы не очень то хорошо показали себя на полигоне.

content.original: Just because you almost blew up the observation bunker...!
content.prevOriginal: Just because you almost blew up the observation bunker...!
content.content: Это лишь потому, что ты чуть было не взорвал наблюдательный бункер...!

content.original: Uh, right. Anyway, Commander, I'm seeing a single {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance, here.
content.prevOriginal: Uh, right. Anyway, Commander, I'm seeing a single {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance, here.
content.content: Эм, ну да. В общем, командующий, я вижу единственное копьё {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} здесь.

content.original: Like, actual {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 'Mechs? With real guns?
content.prevOriginal: Like, actual {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 'Mechs? With real guns?
content.content: Типо, настоящие мехи {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}? С реальным оружием?

content.original: I can't wait! I'm gonna lick their asses!
content.prevOriginal: I can't wait! I'm gonna lick their asses!
content.content: Жду не дождусь! Я им задницы налижу!

content.original: Kick, it's- you know what, never mind. Have fun, Commander. I'll be on station; meet me here when you're ready to leave.
content.prevOriginal: Kick, it's- you know what, never mind. Have fun, Commander. I'll be on station; meet me here when you're ready to leave.
content.content: Надеру, «я им задницы надер...» да, не важно. Развлекайтесь, командир. Я буду на станции; встретимся здесь, когда вы будете готовы к отлету.

content.original: Wait, where are we going? I just figured out how to turn on my radio.
content.prevOriginal: Wait, where are we going? I just figured out how to turn on my radio.
content.content: Погодите, мы куда-то идём? Я только разобрался, как рацию включать.

content.original: That went pretty well! I feel ready for the real thing!
content.prevOriginal: That went pretty well! I feel ready for the real thing!
content.content: Всё прошло довольно хорошо! Я готов к настоящим боям!

content.original: That... was the real thing.
content.prevOriginal: That... was the real thing.
content.content: Это... и был... настоящий бой.

content.original: I think I peed in my cockpit.
content.prevOriginal: I think I peed in my cockpit.
content.content: Кажется я обоссался.

content.original: The primary targets are down, Commander. You can evac at any time.
content.prevOriginal: The primary targets are down, Commander. You can evac at any time.
content.content: Основные цели уничтожены, командир. Вы можете эвакуироваться в любое время.

content.original: Affirmative; I'm on station. Meet me at this LZ.
content.prevOriginal: Affirmative; I'm on station. Meet me at this LZ.
content.content: Принято. Я на платформе. Встретимся у зоны высадки.

content.original: The hostile {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} lance has arrived!
content.prevOriginal: The hostile {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} lance has arrived!
content.content: Отряд противников из {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Name} прибыл!

content.original: Our Employer has kindly added this group to the contract. If we want to get paid we need to take them out.
content.prevOriginal: Our Employer has kindly added this group to the contract. If we want to get paid we need to take them out.
content.content: Наш работодатель любезно добавил эту группу в контракт. Если мы хотим получить зарплату, придётся с ними разобраться.

content.original: Commander? I've got eyes on a new lance in the AO. Looks like {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} markings.
content.prevOriginal: Commander? I've got eyes on a new lance in the AO. Looks like {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} markings.
content.content: Командир? Я заметил новый отряд в зоне действия. Похоже на опознавательные знаки {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Name}.

content.original: Um, was that supposed to happen? What do we do now?
content.prevOriginal: Um, was that supposed to happen? What do we do now?
content.content: Эм, а так и должно было? Что нам теперь делать?

content.original: We kill the new guys, too! Just like in the holovids!
content.prevOriginal: We kill the new guys, too! Just like in the holovids!
content.content: We kill the new guys, too! Just like in the holovids!

content.original: Up to you if you want to engage the new targets, Commander. If not, Sumire will make the pickup at the evac LZ.
content.prevOriginal: Up to you if you want to engage the new targets, Commander. If not, Sumire will make the pickup at the evac LZ.
content.content: Вам решать, хотите ли вы атаковать новые цели, командир. Если нет, Сумир подберет вас в точке эвакуации.

content.prevOriginal: All our objectives are complete, cover our withdraw, Commander.

content.prevOriginal: Thanks for the assist, we're clear.

content.original: We're trying to build a local defense force of MechWarriors here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. Our pilots are inexperienced and untested, and we'd like you to help us train them. We've picked up a troubling signal which may represent hostile activity, which seems like a good opportunity to send our new defense force out to handle it. Can you bring along an experienced MechWarrior and 'Mech to keep them out of trouble?

Мы засекли тревожный сигнал, который может означать враждебную активность, что кажется хорошей возможностью закалить наших воинов. content.original: We're trying to build a local defense force of MechWarriors here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. Our pilots are inexperienced and untested, and we'd like you to help us train them. We've picked up a troubling signal which may represent hostile activity, which seems like a good opportunity to send our new defense force out to handle it. Can you bring along an experienced MechWarrior and 'Mech to keep them out of trouble?
content.prevOriginal: We're trying to build a local defense force of MechWarriors here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. Our pilots are inexperienced and untested, and we'd like you to help us train them. We've picked up a troubling signal which may represent hostile activity, which seems like a good opportunity to send our new defense force out to handle it. Can you bring along an experienced MechWarrior and 'Mech to keep them out of trouble?
content.content: Мы пытаемся создать местные силы обороны из мехвоинов здесь, на {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. Наши пилоты не имеют опыта, и мы бы хотели, чтобы вы помогли нам обучить их. Мы засекли тревожный сигнал, который может означать враждебную активность, что кажется хорошей возможностью закалить наших воинов. Если можно, пришлите одного опытного мехвоина и мех, чтобы уберечь их от неприятностей.

content.original: Flying Tigers
content.prevOriginal: Flying Tigers
content.content: Парящие тигры

content.original: Due to logistical issues we have only a single heavy air asset to task with the destruction of an isolated enemy force. We'd like to hire you to fill out the unit and temporarily place our asset under your control. Arrangements like this have generally worked well for us in the past, however our liability department insists on a deposit of 50% of your negotiated compensation for the safe return of our aircraft. We realize that losses are the reality of combat, but unfortunately some commanders are less than careful with units not regularly attached to their company. I'm sure you can understand our position.
content.prevOriginal: Due to logistical issues we have only a single heavy air asset to task with the destruction of an isolated enemy force. We'd like to hire you to fill out the unit to full strength and provide support.
content.content: Из-за логистических проблем сейчас мы можем выделить только одну единицу авиатехники для уничтожения изолированных вражеских сил. Мы бы хотели нанять вас для формирования полноценной оперативной группы и оказания поддержки.

content.original: With any luck we won't have to do much more than confirm kills, easy money, Commander.
content.prevOriginal: With any luck we won't have to do much more than confirm kills, easy money, Commander.
content.content: Если повезет, нам не придется делать ничего сверх обычных убийств. Легкие деньги, командир.

content.prevOriginal: We're very close to wrapping up this operation successfully. Good luck, Commander.
content.content: Мы очень близки к успешному завершению этой операции. Удачи, командир.

content.prevOriginal: That's a complete success, Commander. We've done it. This world is ready to crack like an egg.

content.prevOriginal: No! We were so close. So very close. We will need to get far away from here.

content.prevOriginal: We'll work in parallel to you and eliminate any opposition we come into contact with.

content.prevOriginal: We're finished, Commander. You're on your own again.
content.content: Мы здесь закончили, командир. Вы снова сами по себе.

content.prevOriginal: Commander, long range sensors are picking up an enemy bogey. They'll be landing any minute.

content.prevOriginal: I don't have any way to know where they will land, but you can bet they will be close to the base.
content.content: У меня нет возможности узнать, где они приземлятся, но готов поспорить - это будет рядом с базой.

content.prevOriginal: Commander, they are depolying vehicles and tanks from their motorpool.

content.prevOriginal: Commander, our window of opportunity for this strike is closing. At least half of our time has expired. You'll need to move quickly if you're to accomplish this.

content.prevOriginal: Commander, my sensors show a large incoming enemy reaction force. Clear out of this AO!

content.prevOriginal: We're holding here for our own reinforcements. Get to your evac point and go! We'll cover you.

content.prevOriginal: CHECK FIRE! CHECK FIRE! FRIENDLIES NOT CLEAR OF IMPACT SITE. OH---

content.prevOriginal: ...so let's scout out the target area. When we've found the convoy, we stop it from reaching its destination.

content.original: Then we make our way to the Evac Zone.
content.prevOriginal: Then we make our way to the Evac Zone.

content.original: Get to it, Commander.
content.prevOriginal: Get to it, Commander.

content.original: Mission accomplished. The fire support vehicles have been neutralized.
content.prevOriginal: Mission accomplished. The fire support vehicles have been neutralized.

content.prevOriginal: Nothing more to do here Commander, let's go home.
content.content: Здесь больше нечего делать, командир, идём домой.

content.prevOriginal: The target vehicles should be just ahead. Be careful Commander, who knows what they're packing.

content.original: That's got it, primary target damaged. Keep the pressure on those.
content.prevOriginal: That's got it, primary target damaged. Keep the pressure on those.

content.prevOriginal: The guard units are dealt with; a wise move.

content.prevOriginal: One down. Keep engaging those threats and we'll be out of here.

content.prevOriginal: The convoy is finished, now get what 'Mechs you have to the extraction point and we'll pull you out. Move quickly.
content.content: С конвоем закончили, теперь ведите всех, кто остался, к точке эвакуации, и мы вас вытащим. Скорей.

content.original: We've got company!
content.prevOriginal: We've got company!
content.content: У нас гости!

content.original: Secret Logistics
content.prevOriginal: Secret Logistics
content.content: Тайная логистика

content.original: A routine orbital survey of {TGT_SYSTEM.name} picked up coded transmissions from the surface. Our intelligence experts believe these transmissions come from a well-hidden {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} facility in this supposedly uninhabited system. Needless to say, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} is not willing to tolerate secret military bases in this region. We need a mercenary company to intercept one of the supply caravans traveling to the secret base. Even if we can't find their facility, we can still starve them out.[WARNING: Zombies]
content.prevOriginal: A routine orbital survey of {TGT_SYSTEM.name} picked up coded transmissions from the surface. We need a mercenary company to intercept one of the supply caravans traveling to the secret base. Even if we can't find their facility, we can still starve them out.[WARNING: Zombies]

Наши эксперты полагают, что эти сообщения поступают из хорошо замаскированного объекта {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} в этой, предположительно необитаемой, системе. Излишне говорить, что {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} не желает мириться с секретными военными базами в этом регионе. Нам нужна команда наёмников, чтобы перехватить один из караванов с припасами, направляющихся на секретную базу. Даже если мы не сможем найти их объект, мы сможем заморить их голодом.[ОСТОРОЖНО: зомби]

content.original: Our employers don't really have any more legitimate a claim to this system than anyone else, but they do have the money to hire us. Which is a solid argument for ownership.
content.prevOriginal: Our employers don't really have any more legitimate a claim to this system than anyone else, but they do have the money to hire us. Which is a solid argument for ownership.

content.original: Contravening all decency and acceptable behavior on the battlefield, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} has been targeting our hospitals and medical supplies. We're seeking to redistribute our supplies to safer locations, but one convoy remains without a proper escort. That's where you come in. While {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces will be stretched thin, attempting to intercept all of our separate shipments, you can expect that this one will not go unnoticed.[WARNING: Zombies]

Мы пытаемся перераспределить припасы в более безопасные места, но один конвой остаётся без надлежащего сопровождения. Вот тут-то вы и придете на помощь. Хотя силы {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} будут растянуты, пытаясь перехватить все наши отдельные грузы, вы можете ожидать, что тот, что за вами, не останется незамеченным.[ОСТОРОЖНО: зомби]

content.original: Hostage Rescue
content.prevOriginal: Hostage Rescue

content.original: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} DropShip went down on this empty rock, and shortly thereafter we detected a distress signal from the surface. By the time we arrived, the crew had been taken captive by a heavily armed {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} force. We don't have an in-system military presence large enough to mount a hostage rescue mission, so we're looking for a competent mercenary company to do it. We need you to reach the facility where the crew is being held, destroy the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units guarding them, and escort them to safety.[WARNING: Zombies]
content.prevOriginal: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} DropShip went down on this empty rock, and shortly thereafter we detected a distress signal from the surface. We don't have an in-system military presence large enough to mount a hostage rescue mission, so we're looking for a competent mercenary company to do it. We need you to reach the facility where the crew is being held, destroy the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units guarding them, and escort them to safety.[WARNING: Zombies]
content.content: Дропшип {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} сел на эту голую скалу, и вскоре после этого послал сигнал бедствия с поверхности. К моменту нашего прибытия экипаж был взят в плен хорошо вооруженными силами {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}. У нас не достаточно военных сил в системе, чтобы организовать миссию по освобождению заложников, поэтому мы ищем компетентную компанию наемников, которая могла бы это сделать. Нам нужно, чтобы вы добрались до объекта, где удерживается экипаж, уничтожили охраняющие их юниты {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} и сопроводили их в безопасное место.[ОСТОРОЖНО: зомби]

content.original: Professional Ethics
content.prevOriginal: Professional Ethics
content.content: профессиональная этика

content.original: We have an extremely odd assignment for you. We have a manufacturing facility on the planet below, and we've been aware that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have been scouting in the area. We've expected them to make a move, but we didn't expect them to... send us a warning beforehand? Apparently they've hired a mercenary who contacted us to let us know when the attack would be, because, and I'm quoting, "professional ethics." We have no idea what that means.[WARNING: Zombies]
content.prevOriginal: We have an extremely odd assignment for you. Мы ожидали их действий, но не ожидали, что... они предупредят нас заранее. Очевидно, они наняли наемника, и тот связался с нами, чтобы сообщить, когда будет атака, потому что, цитирую, «профессиональная этика». Мы понятия не имеем, что это значит.[ОСТОРОЖНО: зомби]

content.content: Действительно. В один прекрасный день мне придется лично выйти в бой против вас.

content.original: That transmission is coming from a relay in orbit. They weren't even here, just remote piloting a 'Mech.
content.prevOriginal: That transmission is coming from a relay in orbit. They weren't even here, just remote piloting a 'Mech.
content.content: Эта передача идет с ретранслятора с орбиты. Их даже не было здесь, они просто удаленно пилотировали мех.

content.original: What a damn disaster. Let's debrief back in orbit.
content.prevOriginal: What a damn disaster. Let's debrief back in orbit.
content.content: Просто катастрофа. Обсудим детали на орбите.

content.original: Argo, my engineers are powering the turrets up now. The APCs will scatter and provide support.
content.prevOriginal: Argo, my engineers are powering the turrets up now. The APCs will scatter and provide support.
content.content: Арго, сейчас мои инженеры активируют турели. БТРы рассредоточатся и окажут поддержку.

content.original: Roger, local command. Commander, looks like we have a few more guns on our side.
content.prevOriginal: Roger, local command. Commander, looks like we have a few more guns on our side.
content.content: Вас понял, штаб. Командир, похоже у нас будет ещё пара стволов на нашей стороне.

content.original: Warning commander, sensors are reading multiple contacts approaching from multiple vectors. Looks like the attacking force has brought reinforcements.
content.prevOriginal: Warning commander, sensors are reading multiple contacts approaching from multiple vectors. Looks like the attacking force has brought reinforcements.
content.content: Предупреждаю, командир, сенсоры фиксируют множественные контакты, приближающиеся с нескольких направлений. Похоже, что атакующие силы привели подкрепление.

content.original: Be advised, some of the target buildings are sustaining damage. Your mission is to keep them standing.
content.prevOriginal: Be advised, some of the target buildings are sustaining damage. Your mission is to keep them standing.
content.content: Имейте в виду, что некоторые целевые здания получают повреждения. Ваша задача - сохранить их в вертикальном положении.

content.original: Commander, a target building has been demolished. Ensure the integrity of the remaining buildings.
content.prevOriginal: Commander, a target building has been demolished. Ensure the integrity of the remaining buildings.
content.content: Командир, целевое здание было разрушено. Обеспечьте сохранность оставшихся.

content.original: My people only have one more building left to destroy. You're not going to at least try and make this a challenge for me?
content.prevOriginal: My people only have one more building left to destroy. You're not going to at least try and make this a challenge for me?
content.content: Моим людям осталось разрушить всего одно здание. Ты не хочешь хотя бы попытаться мне помешать?

content.original: Mercenary Commander, we've received word of the assault on your position. Reinforcements are incoming, they are about halfway there. Maintain position and you will be relieved and reinforced shortly.
content.prevOriginal: Mercenary Commander, we've received word of the assault on your position. Reinforcements are incoming, they are about halfway there. Maintain position and you will be relieved and reinforced shortly.
content.content: Командующий наёмниками, мы получили известие о штурме вашей позиции. Наши подкрепления скоро будут, они примерно на полпути. Держитесь там.

content.original: Argo, this is {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} local command. Our turrets have been disabled by sabotage.
content.prevOriginal: Argo, this is {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} local command. Our turrets have been disabled by sabotage.
content.content: Арго, это местное командование {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}. Наши турели были выведены из строя из-за саботажа.

content.original: Well now there's a surprise.
content.prevOriginal: Well now there's a surprise.
content.content: Ну, а теперь сюрприз.

content.original: That's going to make this mission rough, command. Suggestions?
content.prevOriginal: That's going to make this mission rough, command. Suggestions?
content.content: Это усложнит данную миссию. Какие будут предложения?

content.original: I have a team of engineers that can manually restart the turrets, but that can only be done in person at turret control.
content.prevOriginal: I have a team of engineers that can manually restart the turrets, but that can only be done in person at turret control.
content.content: У меня тут команда инженеров, которые могут перезапустить турели, но это можно сделать только в ручную из центра управления турелями.

content.original: Roger. Commander, if we want any backup, we'll need to keep those APCs alive until they get to the turret control building.
content.prevOriginal: Roger. Commander, if we want any backup, we'll need to keep those APCs alive until they get to the turret control building.
content.content: Вас понял. Командир, если мы хотим хоть какой-нибудь поддержки, нужно защищать эти БТРы, пока они не доберутся до пульта управления турелями.

content.original: Contagion
content.prevOriginal: Contagion
content.content: Заражение

content.original: We've just lost contact with one of our facilities, Commander, and we need your help. Earlier today, our facility here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} received what they believed was a normal data transmission. It was badly garbled, and when they requested it be re-sent, they got no response. Shortly thereafter the base systems began to malfunction, and then we lost contact with both the base and the synchronous satellites covering that region. We'd like you to investigate the facility.[WARNING: Zombies]
content.prevOriginal: We've just lost contact with one of our facilities, Commander, and we need your help. Earlier today, our facility here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} received what they believed was a normal data transmission. It was badly garbled, and when they requested it be re-sent, they got no response. Shortly thereafter the base systems began to malfunction, and then we lost contact with both the base and the synchronous satellites covering that region. We'd like you to investigate the facility.[WARNING: Zombies]
content.content: Мы только что потеряли связь с одним из наших объектов, командир, и нам нужна ваша помощь. Ранее сегодня наш объект на {TGT_SYSTEM.name} получил то, что, по их мнению, было обычной передачей данных. Она была сильно искажена, и когда они запросили ее повторную отправку, то не получили ответа. И вскоре после этого системы базы начали сбоить, а затем мы потеряли связь и с базой, и с передающими спутниками, покрывающими этот регион. Мы бы хотели, чтобы вы проверили объект.[ОСТОРОЖНО: зомби]

content.original: I don't like the sound of this, Commander. No satellite coverage means no topographical intel. We're going into an unknown situation without a map.
content.prevOriginal: I don't like the sound of this, Commander. No satellite coverage means no topographical intel. We're going into an unknown situation without a map.
content.content: Ох не нравится мне это, командир. Отсутствие спутникового покрытия означает отсутствие топографической информации. Мы идем в неизвестность, без карты.

content.prevOriginal: Destroy the Facility
content.content: Уничтожьте объект

content.prevOriginal: Destroy Facility Defenders
content.content: Уничтожьте защитников объекта

content.prevOriginal: Destroy {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Reinforcements

content.prevOriginal: Get to the evac zone
content.content: Доберитесь до зоны эвакуации
