content.original:
What a day for a classic Brawl!
 Our Competitors know their value, and that's why they are here today.
 I hear that one of the Gladiators was offered a cereal box deal and that's why he showed up.
content.prevOriginal:
What a day for a classic Brawl!
 Our Competitors know their value, and that's why they are here today.
 I hear that one of the Gladiators was offered a cereal box deal and that's why he showed up.
content.content:
Прекрасный день для классического мордобоя!
 Наши конкуренты знают себе цену, и поэтому они сегодня здесь.
 Я слышал, что одному из гладиаторов предложили коробку хлопьев, и поэтому он явился.

content.original: I mean a four for one deal! Who could pass that up?!?
content.prevOriginal: I mean a four for one deal! Who could pass that up?!?
content.content: Я имею в виду, сделка «четыре по цене одного»! Да кто от такого откажется?!

content.original:
Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}, we have the perfect weather for this match. 
We are hoping that you can show the audience at home how it's done!
content.prevOriginal:
Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}, we have the perfect weather for this match. 
We are hoping that you can show the audience at home how it's done!
content.content:
Командир {COMMANDER.LastName}, у нас тут идеальная погода для матча. 
Мы все болеем за вас, покажите диванной публике, как надо драться!

content.original: I also have a guest announcer, claims he's a huge fan. Everyone, welcome Darius.
content.prevOriginal: I also have a guest announcer, claims he's a huge fan. Everyone, welcome Darius.
content.content: У меня также есть приглашенный диктор, он сказал, он ваш большой фанат. Все, поприветствуйте Дариуса.

content.original: Heya Duncan!  It's a real honor working with you today.
content.prevOriginal: Heya Duncan!  It's a real honor working with you today.
content.content: Приветствую, Дункан! Для меня большая честь поработать с тобой сегодня.

content.original: Wait... Darius did you plan this?
content.prevOriginal: Wait... Darius did you plan this?
content.content: Погоди... Дариус, это ты это спланировал?

content.original: I know! It's great!
content.prevOriginal: I know! It's great!
content.content: И это здорово!

content.original:
And so, the table is set. At one end, battle-hardened mercenaries. 
At the other, some poorly paid stand ins.
 Thanks for bringing them Darius!
content.prevOriginal:
And so, the table is set. At one end, battle-hardened mercenaries. 
At the other, some poorly paid stand ins.
 Thanks for bringing them Darius!
content.content:
И вот, стол накрыт. На одном конце - закаленные в боях наемники.
На другом - какие-то плохо оплачиваемые выскочки.
 Спасибо, что привел их, Дариус!

content.original: Wow, would you look at that. Looks like the odds makers were way off today.
content.prevOriginal: Wow, would you look at that. Looks like the odds makers were way off today.
content.content: Вау, вы только посмотрите на это. Похоже, что составители прогнозов на матч сегодня сильно ошиблись.

content.original: Amazing, I thought the Commander had it in them!
content.prevOriginal: Amazing, I thought the Commander had it in them!
content.content: Обалдеть, я думал у командира всё схвачено!

content.original: You didn't sound so confident earlier. Some of the in booth audio has already gone viral.
content.prevOriginal: You didn't sound so confident earlier. Some of the in booth audio has already gone viral.
content.content: Ты не так уверенно звучал недавно. Некоторые из тех записей из будки уже завирусились.

content.original: Wait, you said we weren't being recorded!
content.prevOriginal: Wait, you said we weren't being recorded!
content.content: Погоди, говорили же, что нас не записывают!

content.original: Send my regards to the mechbay, rook!!!
content.prevOriginal: Send my regards to the mechbay, rook!!!
content.content: Передавай техам от меня привет, малец!!!

content.original: New contacts on sensors, Commander. These units don't match {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} signatures. We've got a new player on the field.
content.prevOriginal: New contacts on sensors, Commander. These units don't match {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} signatures. We've got a new player on the field.
content.content: Новые цели на радаре, командир. Их сигнатуры не похожи на {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}. Похоже у нас новый игрок на поле.

content.original: Kilo 1-3 just got smoked! Suffering loses over here, Commander! We're still in the fight, but down one.
content.prevOriginal: Kilo 1-3 just got smoked! Suffering loses over here, Commander! We're still in the fight, but down one.
content.content: Нашему «Кило 1-3» только что дали прикурить! Мы тут несём потери, командир! Мы всё ещё в бою, но потеряли одного.

content.original: Grace under fire, folks. Lay it on 'em!
content.prevOriginal: Grace under fire, folks. Lay it on 'em!
content.content: Огонь благодатный, ребята. Поджарьте их!

content.original: We lost Quebec Two Commander.
content.prevOriginal: We lost Quebec Two Commander.
content.content: Мы потеряли «Квебек-2», командир.

content.original: This is Quebec Actual, return fire and check your rear arc!
content.prevOriginal: This is Quebec Actual, return fire and check your rear arc!
content.content: Это Квебек-лидер. Ответный огонь и посматривайте за тылом!

content.prevOriginal: Commander, the friendly {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} has been destroyed.

content.prevOriginal: Commander, our employer's allied forces have been destroyed.
content.content: Командир, союзные силы нашего работодателя уничтожены.

content.prevOriginal: Looks like the other mercs have joined in the fight!
content.content: Похоже, ещё одни наёмники присоединились к бою!

content.original: To say that this fight has just got real, is an understatement!
content.prevOriginal: To say that this fight has just got real, is an understatement!
content.content: Сказать, что этот бой только что стал настоящим - значит ничего не сказать!

content.original: Let's hope their aim is better than their looks.
content.prevOriginal: Let's hope their aim is better than their looks.
content.content: Будем надеяться, что целятся они лучше, чем выглядят.

content.original: Wow. This is the most amazing fight I have seen today!
content.prevOriginal: Wow. This is the most amazing fight I have seen today!
content.content: Вау. Это самый удивительный бой, что я видел за сегодня!

content.content: {COMMANDER.Name}, осторожно, здесь тоже плохие {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Name} парни.

content.prevOriginal: Heads up, Commander. I see Drop Pods inbound.

content.original:
What a day for a classic Brawl!
 Our Competitors know their value, and that's why they are here today.
 I hear that one of the Gladiators was offered a cereal box deal and that's why he showed up.
content.prevOriginal:
What a day for a classic Brawl!
 Our Competitors know their value, and that's why they are here today.
 I hear that one of the Gladiators was offered a cereal box deal and that's why he showed up.
content.content:
Прекрасный день для классического мордобоя!
 Наши конкуренты знают себе цену, и поэтому они сегодня здесь.
 Я слышал, что одному из гладиаторов предложили коробку хлопьев, и поэтому он явился.

content.original: I mean a four for one deal! Who could pass that up?!?
content.prevOriginal: I mean a four for one deal! Who could pass that up?!?
content.content: Я имею в виду, сделка «четыре по цене одного»! Да кто от такого откажется?!

content.original:
Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}, we have the perfect weather for this match. 
We are hoping that you can show the audience at home how it's done!
content.prevOriginal:
Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}, we have the perfect weather for this match. 
We are hoping that you can show the audience at home how it's done!
content.content:
Командир {COMMANDER.LastName}, у нас тут идеальная погода для матча. 
Мы все болеем за вас, покажите диванной публике, как надо драться!

content.original: I also have a guest announcer, claims he's a huge fan. Everyone, welcome Darius.
content.prevOriginal: I also have a guest announcer, claims he's a huge fan. Everyone, welcome Darius.
content.content: У меня также есть приглашенный диктор, он сказал, он ваш большой фанат. Все, поприветствуйте Дариуса.

content.original: Heya Duncan! It's a real honor working with you today.
content.prevOriginal: Heya Duncan! It's a real honor working with you today.
content.content: Приветствую, Дункан! Для меня большая честь поработать с тобой сегодня.

content.original: Wait... Darius did you plan this?
content.prevOriginal: Wait... Darius did you plan this?
content.content: Погоди... Дариус, это ты это спланировал?

content.original: I know! It's great!
content.prevOriginal: I know! It's great!
content.content: И это здорово!

content.original:
And so, the table is set. At one end, battle-hardened mercenaries. 
At the other, some poorly paid stand ins.
 Thanks for bringing them Darius!
content.prevOriginal:
And so, the table is set. At one end, battle-hardened mercenaries. 
At the other, some poorly paid stand ins.
 Thanks for bringing them Darius!
content.content:
И вот, стол накрыт. На одном конце - закаленные в боях наемники.
На другом - какие-то плохо оплачиваемые выскочки.
 Спасибо, что привел их, Дариус!

content.original: Wow, would you look at that. Looks like the odds makers were way off today.
content.prevOriginal: Wow, would you look at that. Looks like the odds makers were way off today.
content.content: Вау, вы только посмотрите на это. Похоже, что составители прогнозов на матч сегодня сильно ошиблись.

content.original: Amazing, I thought the Commander had it in them!
content.prevOriginal: Amazing, I thought the Commander had it in them!
content.content: Обалдеть, я думал у командира всё схвачено!

content.original: You didn't sound so confident earlier. Some of the in booth audio has already gone viral.
content.prevOriginal: You didn't sound so confident earlier. Some of the in booth audio has already gone viral.
content.content: Ты не так уверенно звучал недавно. Некоторые из тех записей из будки уже завирусились.

content.original: Wait, you said we weren't being recorded!
content.prevOriginal: Wait, you said we weren't being recorded!
content.content: Погоди, говорили же, что нас не записывают!

content.original: Maybe you should try again later. Much, much later!
content.prevOriginal: Maybe you should try again later. Much, much later!
content.content: Можно ещё раз попробовать, но только позже. Сильно, сильно позже.

content.original: New contacts on sensors, Commander. These units don't match {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} signatures. We've got a new player on the field.
content.prevOriginal: New contacts on sensors, Commander. These units don't match {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} signatures. We've got a new player on the field.
content.content: Новые цели на радаре, командир. Их сигнатуры не похожи на {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}. Похоже у нас новый игрок на поле.

content.original: Kilo 1-3 just got smoked! Suffering loses over here, Commander! We're still in the fight, but down one.
content.prevOriginal: Kilo 1-3 just got smoked! Suffering loses over here, Commander! We're still in the fight, but down one.
content.content: Нашему «Кило 1-3» только что дали прикурить! Мы тут несём потери, командир! Мы всё ещё в бою, но потеряли одного.

content.original: Grace under fire, folks. Lay it on 'em!
content.prevOriginal: Grace under fire, folks. Lay it on 'em!
content.content: Огонь благодатный, ребята. Поджарьте их!

content.original: We lost Quebec Two Commander.
content.prevOriginal: We lost Quebec Two Commander.
content.content: Мы потеряли «Квебек-2», командир.

content.original: This is Quebec Actual, return fire and check your rear arc!
content.prevOriginal: This is Quebec Actual, return fire and check your rear arc!
content.content: Это Квебек-лидер. Ответный огонь и посматривайте за тылом!

content.original: Commander, the friendly {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} has been destroyed.
content.prevOriginal: Commander, the friendly {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} has been destroyed.
content.content: Командир, друзья из {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} были уничтожены.

content.original: Commander, our employer's allied forces have been destroyed.
content.prevOriginal: Commander, our employer's allied forces have been destroyed.
content.content: Командир, союзные силы нашего работодателя уничтожены.

content.original: Looks like the other mercs have joined in the fight!
content.prevOriginal: Looks like the other mercs have joined in the fight!
content.content: Похоже, ещё одни наёмники присоединились к бою!

content.original: To say that this fight has just got real, is an understatement!
content.prevOriginal: To say that this fight has just got real, is an understatement!
content.content: Сказать, что этот бой только что стал настоящим - значит ничего не сказать!

content.original: Let's hope their aim is better than their looks.

content.original:
What a day for a classic Brawl!
 Our Competitors know their value, and that's why they are here today.
 I hear that one of the Gladiators was offered a cereal box deal and that's why he showed up.
content.prevOriginal:
What a day for a classic Brawl!
 Our Competitors know their value, and that's why they are here today.
 I hear that one of the Gladiators was offered a cereal box deal and that's why he showed up.
content.content:
Прекрасный день для классического мордобоя!
 Наши конкуренты знают себе цену, и поэтому они сегодня здесь.
 Я слышал, что одному из гладиаторов предложили коробку хлопьев, и поэтому он явился.

content.original: I mean a four for one deal! Who could pass that up?!?
content.prevOriginal: I mean a four for one deal! Who could pass that up?!?
content.content: Я имею в виду, сделка «четыре по цене одного»! Да кто от такого откажется?!

content.original:
Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}, we have the perfect weather for this match. 
We are hoping that you can show the audience at home how it's done!
content.prevOriginal:
Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}, we have the perfect weather for this match. 
We are hoping that you can show the audience at home how it's done!
content.content:
Командир {COMMANDER.LastName}, у нас тут идеальная погода для матча. 
Мы все болеем за вас, покажите диванной публике, как надо драться!

content.original: I also have a guest announcer, claims he's a huge fan. Everyone, welcome Darius.
content.prevOriginal: I also have a guest announcer, claims he's a huge fan. Everyone, welcome Darius.
content.content: У меня также есть приглашенный диктор, он сказал, он ваш большой фанат. Все, поприветствуйте Дариуса.

content.original: Heya Duncan! It's a real honor working with you today.
content.prevOriginal: Heya Duncan! It's a real honor working with you today.
content.content: Приветствую, Дункан! Для меня большая честь поработать с тобой сегодня.

content.original: Wait... Darius did you plan this?
content.prevOriginal: Wait... Darius did you plan this?
content.content: Погоди... Дариус, это ты это спланировал?

content.original: I know! It's great!
content.prevOriginal: I know! It's great!
content.content: И это здорово!

content.original:
And so, the table is set. At one end, battle-hardened mercenaries. 
At the other, some poorly paid stand ins.
 Thanks for bringing them Darius!
content.prevOriginal:
And so, the table is set. At one end, battle-hardened mercenaries. 
At the other, some poorly paid stand ins.
 Thanks for bringing them Darius!
content.content:
И вот, стол накрыт. На одном конце - закаленные в боях наемники.
На другом - какие-то плохо оплачиваемые выскочки.
 Спасибо, что привел их, Дариус!

content.original: Wow, would you look at that. Looks like the odds makers were way off today.
content.prevOriginal: Wow, would you look at that. Looks like the odds makers were way off today.
content.content: Вау, вы только посмотрите на это. Похоже, что составители прогнозов на матч сегодня сильно ошиблись.

content.original: Amazing, I thought the Commander had it in them!
content.prevOriginal: Amazing, I thought the Commander had it in them!
content.content: Обалдеть, я думал у командира всё схвачено!

content.original: You didn't sound so confident earlier. Some of the in booth audio has already gone viral.
content.prevOriginal: You didn't sound so confident earlier. Some of the in booth audio has already gone viral.
content.content: Ты не так уверенно звучал недавно. Некоторые из тех записей из будки уже завирусились.

content.original: Wait, you said we weren't being recorded!
content.prevOriginal: Wait, you said we weren't being recorded!
content.content: Погоди, говорили же, что нас не записывают!

content.original: Maybe you should try again later. Much, much later!
content.prevOriginal: Maybe you should try again later. Much, much later!
content.content: Можно ещё раз попробовать, но только позже. Сильно, сильно позже.

content.original: New contacts on sensors, Commander. These units don't match {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} signatures. We've got a new player on the field.
content.prevOriginal: New contacts on sensors, Commander. These units don't match {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} signatures. We've got a new player on the field.
content.content: Новые цели на радаре, командир. Их сигнатуры не похожи на {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}. Похоже у нас новый игрок на поле.

content.original: Kilo 1-3 just got smoked! Suffering loses over here, Commander! We're still in the fight, but down one.
content.prevOriginal: Kilo 1-3 just got smoked! Suffering loses over here, Commander! We're still in the fight, but down one.
content.content: Нашему «Кило 1-3» только что дали прикурить! Мы тут несём потери, командир! Мы всё ещё в бою, но потеряли одного.

content.original: Grace under fire, folks. Lay it on 'em!
content.prevOriginal: Grace under fire, folks. Lay it on 'em!
content.content: Огонь благодатный, ребята. Поджарьте их!

content.original: We lost Quebec Two Commander.
content.prevOriginal: We lost Quebec Two Commander.
content.content: Мы потеряли «Квебек-2», командир.

content.original: This is Quebec Actual, return fire and check your rear arc!
content.prevOriginal: This is Quebec Actual, return fire and check your rear arc!
content.content: Это Квебек-лидер. Ответный огонь и посматривайте за тылом!

content.prevOriginal: Commander, the friendly {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} has been destroyed.
content.content: Командир, друзья из {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} были уничтожены.

content.prevOriginal: Commander, our employer's allied forces have been destroyed.
content.content: Командир, союзные силы нашего работодателя уничтожены.

content.prevOriginal: Looks like the other mercs have joined in the fight!
content.content: Похоже, ещё одни наёмники присоединились к бою!

content.original: To say that this fight has just got real, is an understatement!
content.prevOriginal: To say that this fight has just got real, is an understatement!
content.content: Сказать, что этот бой только что стал настоящим - значит ничего не сказать!

content.prevOriginal: Let's hope their aim is better than their looks.

content.prevOriginal: Wow. This is the most amazing fight I have seen today!
content.content: Вау. Это самый удивительный бой, что я видел за сегодня!

content.original:
What a day for a classic Brawl!
 Our Competitors know their value, and that's why they are here today.
 I hear that one of the Gladiators was offered a cereal box deal and that's why he showed up.
content.prevOriginal:
What a day for a classic Brawl!
 Our Competitors know their value, and that's why they are here today.
 I hear that one of the Gladiators was offered a cereal box deal and that's why he showed up.
content.content:
Прекрасный день для классического мордобоя!
 Наши конкуренты знают себе цену, и поэтому они сегодня здесь.
 Я слышал, что одному из гладиаторов предложили коробку хлопьев, и поэтому он явился.

content.original: I mean a four for one deal! Who could pass that up?!?
content.prevOriginal: I mean a four for one deal! Who could pass that up?!?
content.content: Я имею в виду, сделка «четыре по цене одного»! Да кто от такого откажется?!

content.original:
Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}, we have the perfect weather for this match. 
We are hoping that you can show the audience at home how it's done!
content.prevOriginal:
Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}, we have the perfect weather for this match. 
We are hoping that you can show the audience at home how it's done!
content.content:
Командир {COMMANDER.LastName}, у нас тут идеальная погода для матча. 
Мы все болеем за вас, покажите диванной публике, как надо драться!

content.original: I also have a guest announcer, claims he's a huge fan. Everyone, welcome Darius.
content.prevOriginal: I also have a guest announcer, claims he's a huge fan. Everyone, welcome Darius.
content.content: У меня также есть приглашенный диктор, он сказал, он ваш большой фанат. Все, поприветствуйте Дариуса.

content.original: Heya Duncan! It's a real honor working with you today.
content.prevOriginal: Heya Duncan! It's a real honor working with you today.
content.content: Приветствую, Дункан! Для меня большая честь поработать с тобой сегодня.

content.original: Wait... Darius did you plan this?
content.prevOriginal: Wait... Darius did you plan this?
content.content: Погоди... Дариус, это ты это спланировал?

content.original: I know! It's great!
content.prevOriginal: I know! It's great!
content.content: И это здорово!

content.original:
And so, the table is set. At one end, battle-hardened mercenaries. 
At the other, some poorly paid stand ins.
 Thanks for bringing them Darius!
content.prevOriginal:
And so, the table is set. At one end, battle-hardened mercenaries. 
At the other, some poorly paid stand ins.
 Thanks for bringing them Darius!
content.content:
И вот, стол накрыт. На одном конце - закаленные в боях наемники.
На другом - какие-то плохо оплачиваемые выскочки.
 Спасибо, что привел их, Дариус!

content.original: Wow, would you look at that. Looks like the odds makers were way off today.
content.prevOriginal: Wow, would you look at that. Looks like the odds makers were way off today.
content.content: Вау, вы только посмотрите на это. Похоже, что составители прогнозов на матч сегодня сильно ошиблись.

content.original: Amazing, I thought the Commander had it in them!
content.prevOriginal: Amazing, I thought the Commander had it in them!
content.content: Обалдеть, я думал у командира всё схвачено!

content.original: You didn't sound so confident earlier. Some of the in booth audio has already gone viral.
content.prevOriginal: You didn't sound so confident earlier. Some of the in booth audio has already gone viral.
content.content: Ты не так уверенно звучал недавно. Некоторые из тех записей из будки уже завирусились.

content.original: Wait, you said we weren't being recorded!
content.prevOriginal: Wait, you said we weren't being recorded!
content.content: Погоди, говорили же, что нас не записывают!

content.original: Send my regards to the mechbay, rook!!!
content.prevOriginal: Send my regards to the mechbay, rook!!!
content.content: Передавай техам от меня привет, малец!!!

content.original: New contacts on sensors, Commander. These units don't match {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} signatures. We've got a new player on the field.
content.prevOriginal: New contacts on sensors, Commander. These units don't match {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} signatures. We've got a new player on the field.
content.content: Новые цели на радаре, командир. Их сигнатуры не похожи на {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}. Похоже у нас новый игрок на поле.

content.original: Kilo 1-3 just got smoked! Suffering loses over here, Commander! We're still in the fight, but down one.
content.prevOriginal: Kilo 1-3 just got smoked! Suffering loses over here, Commander! We're still in the fight, but down one.
content.content: Нашему «Кило 1-3» только что дали прикурить! Мы тут несём потери, командир! Мы всё ещё в бою, но потеряли одного.

content.original: Grace under fire, folks. Lay it on 'em!
content.prevOriginal: Grace under fire, folks. Lay it on 'em!
content.content: Огонь благодатный, ребята. Поджарьте их!

content.original: We lost Quebec Two Commander.
content.prevOriginal: We lost Quebec Two Commander.
content.content: Мы потеряли «Квебек-2», командир.

content.original: This is Quebec Actual, return fire and check your rear arc!
content.prevOriginal: This is Quebec Actual, return fire and check your rear arc!
content.content: Это Квебек-лидер. Ответный огонь и посматривайте за тылом!

content.original: Commander, the friendly {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} has been destroyed.
content.prevOriginal: Commander, the friendly {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} has been destroyed.
content.content: Командир, друзья из {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} были уничтожены.

content.original: Commander, our employer's allied forces have been destroyed.
content.prevOriginal: Commander, our employer's allied forces have been destroyed.
content.content: Командир, союзные силы нашего работодателя уничтожены.

content.original: Looks like the other mercs have joined in the fight!
content.prevOriginal: Looks like the other mercs have joined in the fight!
content.content: Похоже, ещё одни наёмники присоединились к бою!

content.original: To say that this fight has just got real, is an understatement!
content.prevOriginal: To say that this fight has just got real, is an understatement!
content.content: Сказать, что этот бой только что стал настоящим - значит ничего не сказать!

content.original: Let's hope their aim is better than their looks.
content.prevOriginal: Let's hope their aim is better than their looks.
content.content: Будем надеяться, что целятся они лучше, чем выглядят.

content.original: Wow. This is the most amazing fight I have seen today!
content.prevOriginal: Wow. This is the most amazing fight I have seen today!
content.content: Вау. Это самый удивительный бой, что я видел за сегодня!

content.original: {COMMANDER.Name} look out, there's {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} bad guys here too. Don't that beat it all.
content.prevOriginal: {COMMANDER.Name} look out, there's {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} bad guys here too. Don't that beat it all.
content.content: {COMMANDER.Name}, осторожно, здесь тоже плохие {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Name} парни.

content.original: Our employer has offered a bonus if we eliminate this group as well.
content.prevOriginal: Our employer has offered a bonus if we eliminate this group as well.
content.content: Наш работодатель предложил бонус, если мы устраним и эту группу.

content.original: Primary targets destroyed Commander.
content.prevOriginal: Primary targets destroyed Commander.
content.content: Основные цели уничтожены, командир.

content.original: I'm inbound to the LZ Commander.
content.prevOriginal: I'm inbound to the LZ Commander.
content.content: Прибываю на место посадки, командир.

content.original: There were far more prisoners than originally anticipated, but thankfully due to your company's bravery and my quick thinking we were able to rescue them all. However, in the kerfuffle, one of the weeb leaders responsible for this outrage has blockaded our escape route. We’ll have to teleport behind them and take their forces down before we can escape. Don't let these fools stand in our way for a moment longer, let's show them the fury of a Canopian scorned.
content.prevOriginal: There were far more prisoners than originally anticipated, but thankfully due to your companies bravery and my quick thinking we were able to rescue them all. Don't let these fools stand in our way for a moment longer, let's show them the fury of a Canopian scorned.
content.content: Пленников оказалось гораздо больше, чем предполагалось, но, к счастью, благодаря храбрости вашей компании и моей смекалке нам удалось спасти их всех. Однако во время переполоха один из лидеров вибов, ответственных за это безобразие, перекрыл нам путь к отступлению. Нам придется переброситься к ним и уничтожить их силы, чтобы можно было сбежать. Не позволяйте этим глупцам стоять на нашем пути ни секунды дольше, давайте покажем им ярость канопианца.

content.original: I'd usually expect well trained pilots with expensive gear Commander, but this time I'm not so sure. You'll have to assess the situation for yourself, but all this 'training' of theirs might just be nonsense. As always, use caution. We can't fail now.

Это будет непросто, поскольку, пока мы эвакуировали пленных, сюда съехались дополнительные силы, и они удерживают эту позицию. Они, и ещё тяжелые турели...

content.original: A lance of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} BattleMechs has been rampaging in {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} territory on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. They've been razing population centers, burning fields and refineries, looting storage facilities. They're clearly doing everything they can think of to drive our people out. This is terrorism, pure and simple. We need you to find them and destroy them - no escape, no parlay, and no prisoners.

content.original: The transmission data was enough for us to locate the fortified bunker that the regional Maximum Distric Leadership is hiding in. They think they're safe in there, but we've got a naval PPC on station ready to punch a hole in anything they've built down there. You'll need to move your 'Mechs into position so that we can make a precise attack; once we take this shot, our DropShip is going to have to break orbit and run, so there's only one chance to get this right. We have complete confidence in you, Commander; your judgment has been spot-on so far. Good luck.
content.prevOriginal: The transmission data was enough for us to locate the fortified bunker that the regional Maximum Distric Leadership is hiding in. You'll need to move your 'Mechs into position so that we can make a precise attack; once we take this shot, our DropShip is going to have to break orbit and run, so there's only one chance to get this right. We have complete confidence in you, Commander; your judgment has been spot-on so far. Good luck.
content.content: Переданных данных оказалось достаточно, чтобы мы смогли обнаружить укрепленный бункер, в котором прячется региональное руководство Maximum Distric Leadership. Они думают, что там им ничего не грозит, но у нас на орбите есть корабельная PPC, готовая проделать дыру во всем, что они там построили. Вам нужно вывести свои мехи на позицию, чтобы мы могли провести точечную атаку; как только мы сделаем выстрел, нашему кораблю придется сорваться с орбиты и бежать, так что у нас есть только один шанс сделать всё правильно. Мы полностью доверяем вам, командир; до сих пор ваши действия были безупречными. Удачи.

content.original: A routine orbital survey of {TGT_SYSTEM.name} picked up coded transmissions from the surface. Our intelligence experts believe these transmissions come from a well-hidden {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} facility in this supposedly uninhabited system. Needless to say, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} is not willing to tolerate secret military bases in this region. We need a mercenary company to intercept one of the supply caravans traveling to the secret base. Even if we can't find their facility, we can still starve them out.[WARNING: Zombies]

Нам нужна команда наёмников, чтобы перехватить один из караванов с припасами, направляющихся на секретную базу. Даже если мы не сможем найти их объект, мы сможем заморить их голодом.

content.original: Commander, we need an immediate deployment. We've been in pursuit of a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} terrorist for months, and we've finally tracked them to this planet. They've gone to ground but earlier today one of our orbital units spotted them moving on the surface. This is the first verified sighting we've had of the target, and we want you to bring them down immediately, before they're able to slip away again. There hasn't been time to do a full survey of the AO, so you'll be going in blind.[WARNING: Zombies]

Это первое подтвержденное обнаружение цели, и мы хотим, чтобы вы немедленно уничтожили их, пока они не смогли снова ускользнуть. У нас не было времени провести полное обследование зоны операции, поэтому вы будете действовать вслепую.

Analysis suggests that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} has reactivated an abandoned factory on the planet's surface. We don't know what this particular facility was used for, but given the effort they're sinking into this, it must be valuable. We want it.[WARNING: Zombies]

content.prevOriginal: Uh, folks? I just spotted more engine signatures -- 'Mechs powering up. More bad guys are on their way to you, boss.

content.original: Aborted Colony
content.prevOriginal: Aborted Colony
content.content: Покинутая колония

content.original: This system was targeted as part of a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} expansion plan. Unfortunately, the colonial plan fell through, and we now have to extract our people from the planet's surface before they're intercepted by hostile forces. As the colony was a secret, thanks to the conflicting and dubious claims on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}, we cannot be seen to mount a major rescue operation. We need a deniable middle-man.[WARNING: Zombies]
content.prevOriginal: This system was targeted as part of a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} expansion plan. content.content: Эта система была выбрана как часть плана расширения {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}. К сожалению, план колонизации провалился, и теперь мы должны забрать наших людей с планеты, пока их не перехватили враждебные силы. Поскольку колония была секретной, спасибо сомнительным претензиям на {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} других сторон, мы не должны быть замечены в проведении спасательных операций. Нам нужен посредник, связь с которым мы могли бы отрицать.

content.prevOriginal: Appearances
content.content: Внешний вид

content.original: Contravening all decency and acceptable behavior on the battlefield, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} has been targeting our hospitals and medical supplies. We're seeking to redistribute our supplies to safer locations, but one convoy remains without a proper escort. That's where you come in. While {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces will be stretched thin, attempting to intercept all of our separate shipments, you can expect that this one will not go unnoticed.[WARNING: Zombies]
content.prevOriginal: Contravening all decency and acceptable behavior on the battlefield, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} has been targeting our hospitals and medical supplies. Мы пытаемся перераспределить припасы в более безопасные места, но один конвой остаётся без надлежащего сопровождения. Вот тут-то вы и придете на помощь. Хотя силы {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} будут растянуты, пытаясь перехватить все наши отдельные грузы, вы можете ожидать, что тот, что за вами, не останется незамеченным.

content.original: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} DropShip went down on this empty rock, and shortly thereafter we detected a distress signal from the surface. By the time we arrived, the crew had been taken captive by a heavily armed {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} force. We don't have an in-system military presence large enough to mount a hostage rescue mission, so we're looking for a competent mercenary company to do it. We need you to reach the facility where the crew is being held, destroy the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units guarding them, and escort them to safety.[WARNING: Zombies]

content.prevOriginal: Commander, we can't afford to lose any more structures, or we'll be in breach of the contract.
content.content: Командир, мы не можем позволить себе потерять больше построек, иначе мы провалим это задание.

content.original: Mercenary Commander, we've received word of the assault on your position. Reinforcements are incoming, they are about halfway there. Maintain position and you will be relieved and reinforced shortly.
content.prevOriginal: Mercenary Commander, we've received word of the assault on your position. Reinforcements are incoming, they are about halfway there. Maintain position and you will be relieved and reinforced shortly.
content.content: Командующий наёмниками, мы получили известие о штурме вашей позиции. Наши подкрепления скоро будут, они примерно на полпути. Держитесь там.

content.original: Commander, on this outing we have some additional support from our employer.
content.prevOriginal: Commander, on this outing we have some additional support from our employer.
content.content: Командир, на этой прогулке наниматель предоставит нам дополнительную поддержку.

content.original: They have point defenses set up around the base, they are however offline.
content.prevOriginal: They have point defenses set up around the base, they are however offline.
content.content: Вокруг базы установлены точечные системы обороны, хотя они сейчас отключены.

content.original: We have a friendly convoy with engineers who are eager to get at those defenses, so they can bring them online.
content.prevOriginal: We have a friendly convoy with engineers who are eager to get at those defenses, so they can bring them online.
content.content: С нами конвой с инженерами, которые горят желанием добраться до этих оборонительных сооружений, чтобы ввести их в строй.

content.original: Escort them safely to the generators and we can boost our defensive capability with those turrets activated. Good Luck!
content.prevOriginal: Escort them safely to the generators and we can boost our defensive capability with those turrets activated. Good Luck!
content.content: Безопасно доведите их до генераторов, и мы сможем усилить нашу оборону, активировав эти турели. Удачи!

content.original: Professional Ethics
content.prevOriginal: Professional Ethics
content.content: профессиональная этика

content.original: We have an extremely odd assignment for you. We have a manufacturing facility on the planet below, and we've been aware that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have been scouting in the area. We've expected them to make a move, but we didn't expect them to... send us a warning beforehand? Apparently they've hired a mercenary who contacted us to let us know when the attack would be, because, and I'm quoting, "professional ethics." We have no idea what that means.[WARNING: Zombies]
content.prevOriginal: We have an extremely odd assignment for you. We have a manufacturing facility on the planet below, and we've been aware that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have been scouting in the area. We've expected them to make a move, but we didn't expect them to... send us a warning beforehand? Apparently they've hired a mercenary who contacted us to let us know when the attack would be, because, and I'm quoting, "professional ethics." We have no idea what that means.
content.content: У нас для вас чрезвычайно необычное задание. У нас есть производственный комплекс на планете внизу, и мы знали, что силы {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} вели разведку в этом районе. Мы ожидали их действий, но не ожидали, что... они предупредят нас заранее. Очевидно, они наняли наемника, и тот связался с нами, чтобы сообщить, когда будет атака, потому что, цитирую, «профессиональная этика». Мы понятия не имеем, что это значит.

content.original: Why would anyone give their target a warning? And what the hell does 'professional ethics' mean? This is bizarre.
content.prevOriginal: Why would anyone give their target a warning? And what the hell does 'professional ethics' mean? This is bizarre.
content.content: Зачем кому-то предупреждать свою цель? И что, черт возьми, означает «профессиональная этика»? Чушь какая-то.

content.prevOriginal: Optional objective to keep ALL target structures intact.
content.content: Необязательная цель - сохраните ВСЕ отмеченные здания.

content.content: Hidden Objective: Уничтожьте второе копьё

content.original: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Third Lance
content.prevOriginal: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Third Lance
content.content: Скрытая цель: уничтожить третий отряд

content.original: The manufacturing facility is just up ahead. Meyer, any sign of our polite opposition?
content.prevOriginal: The manufacturing facility is just up ahead. Meyer, any sign of our polite opposition?
content.content: Производственный комплекс прямо впереди. Мейер, есть какие-нибудь признаки нашей вежливой оппозиции?

content.original: I'm seeing... uh, I'm seeing a lot of engine signatures out there, XO.
content.prevOriginal: I'm seeing... uh, I'm seeing a lot of engine signatures out there, XO.
content.content: Я вижу... э-э, я вижу там много сигнатур двигателей, старший помощник.

content.original: I gave you plenty of time to prepare. Did you think I wouldn't prepare as well?
content.prevOriginal: I gave you plenty of time to prepare. Did you think I wouldn't prepare as well?
content.content: Я дал вам достаточно времени для подготовки. Неужели вы думаете я не подготовился сам?

content.original: I don't get it. What's the point of this?
content.prevOriginal: I don't get it. What's the point of this?
content.content: Я не понимаю. Какой в этом смысл?

content.original: To prove which of us is better: your whole company... or me.
content.prevOriginal: To prove which of us is better: your whole company... or me.
content.content: Чтобы доказать, кто из нас лучше: вся ваша компания... или я.

content.original: I suppose this means we're the better mercenaries, though I'm not sure why we needed to know that.
content.prevOriginal: I suppose this means we're the better mercenaries, though I'm not sure why we needed to know that.
content.content: Полагаю, это означает, что это мы - наёмники «те, что получше», хотя и не уверен, зачем нам надо было это знать.

content.original: Indeed. One of these days I'll have to take the field against you personally.
content.prevOriginal: Indeed. One of these days I'll have to take the field against you personally.
content.content: Действительно. В один прекрасный день мне придется лично выйти в бой против вас.

content.original: That transmission is coming from a relay in orbit. They weren't even here, just remote piloting a 'Mech.
content.prevOriginal: That transmission is coming from a relay in orbit. They weren't even here, just remote piloting a 'Mech.
content.content: Эта передача идет с ретранслятора с орбиты. Их даже не было здесь, они просто удаленно пилотировали мех.

content.original: What a damn disaster. Let's debrief back in orbit.
content.prevOriginal: What a damn disaster. Let's debrief back in orbit.
content.content: Просто катастрофа. Обсудим детали на орбите.

content.original: Argo, my engineers are powering the turrets up now. The APCs will scatter and provide support.
content.prevOriginal: Argo, my engineers are powering the turrets up now. The APCs will scatter and provide support.
content.content: Арго, сейчас мои инженеры активируют турели. БТРы рассредоточатся и окажут поддержку.

content.original: Roger, local command. Commander, looks like we have a few more guns on our side.
content.prevOriginal: Roger, local command. Commander, looks like we have a few more guns on our side.
content.content: Вас понял, штаб. Командир, похоже у нас будет ещё пара стволов на нашей стороне.

content.original: Warning commander, sensors are reading multiple contacts approaching from multiple vectors. Looks like the attacking force has brought reinforcements.
content.prevOriginal: Warning commander, sensors are reading multiple contacts approaching from multiple vectors. Looks like the attacking force has brought reinforcements.
content.content: Предупреждаю, командир, сенсоры фиксируют множественные контакты, приближающиеся с нескольких направлений. Похоже, что атакующие силы привели подкрепление.

content.original: Be advised, some of the target buildings are sustaining damage. Your mission is to keep them standing.
content.prevOriginal: Be advised, some of the target buildings are sustaining damage. Your mission is to keep them standing.
content.content: Имейте в виду, что некоторые целевые здания получают повреждения. Ваша задача - сохранить их в вертикальном положении.

content.original: Commander, a target building has been demolished. Ensure the integrity of the remaining buildings.
content.prevOriginal: Commander, a target building has been demolished. Ensure the integrity of the remaining buildings.
content.content: Командир, целевое здание было разрушено. Обеспечьте сохранность оставшихся.

content.original: My people only have one more building left to destroy. You're not going to at least try and make this a challenge for me?
content.prevOriginal: My people only have one more building left to destroy. You're not going to at least try and make this a challenge for me?
content.content: Моим людям осталось разрушить всего одно здание. Ты не хочешь хотя бы попытаться мне помешать?

content.original: Mercenary Commander, we've received word of the assault on your position. Reinforcements are incoming, they are about halfway there. Maintain position and you will be relieved and reinforced shortly.
content.prevOriginal: Mercenary Commander, we've received word of the assault on your position. Reinforcements are incoming, they are about halfway there. Maintain position and you will be relieved and reinforced shortly.
content.content: Командующий наёмниками, мы получили известие о штурме вашей позиции. Наши подкрепления скоро будут, они примерно на полпути. Держитесь там.

content.original: Argo, this is {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} local command. Our turrets have been disabled by sabotage.
content.prevOriginal: Argo, this is {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} local command. Our turrets have been disabled by sabotage.
content.content: Арго, это местное командование {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}. Наши турели были выведены из строя из-за саботажа.

content.original: Well now there's a surprise.
content.prevOriginal: Well now there's a surprise.
content.content: Ну, а теперь сюрприз.

content.original: That's going to make this mission rough, command. Suggestions?
content.prevOriginal: That's going to make this mission rough, command. Suggestions?
content.content: Это усложнит данную миссию. Какие будут предложения?

content.original: I have a team of engineers that can manually restart the turrets, but that can only be done in person at turret control.
content.prevOriginal: I have a team of engineers that can manually restart the turrets, but that can only be done in person at turret control.
content.content: У меня тут команда инженеров, которые могут перезапустить турели, но это можно сделать только в ручную из центра управления турелями.

content.original: Roger. Commander, if we want any backup, we'll need to keep those APCs alive until they get to the turret control building.
content.prevOriginal: Roger. Commander, if we want any backup, we'll need to keep those APCs alive until they get to the turret control building.
content.content: Вас понял. Командир, если мы хотим хоть какой-нибудь поддержки, нужно защищать эти БТРы, пока они не доберутся до пульта управления турелями.

content.original: Contagion
content.prevOriginal: Contagion
content.content: Заражение

content.original: We've just lost contact with one of our facilities, Commander, and we need your help. Earlier today, our facility here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} received what they believed was a normal data transmission. It was badly garbled, and when they requested it be re-sent, they got no response. Shortly thereafter the base systems began to malfunction, and then we lost contact with both the base and the synchronous satellites covering that region. We'd like you to investigate the facility.[WARNING: Zombies]
content.prevOriginal: We've just lost contact with one of our facilities, Commander, and we need your help. Earlier today, our facility here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} received what they believed was a normal data transmission. It was badly garbled, and when they requested it be re-sent, they got no response. Shortly thereafter the base systems began to malfunction, and then we lost contact with both the base and the synchronous satellites covering that region. We'd like you to investigate the facility.
content.content: Мы только что потеряли связь с одним из наших объектов, командир, и нам нужна ваша помощь. Ранее сегодня наш объект на {TGT_SYSTEM.name} получил то, что, по их мнению, было обычной передачей данных. Она была сильно искажена, и когда они запросили ее повторную отправку, то не получили ответа. И вскоре после этого системы базы начали сбоить, а затем мы потеряли связь и с базой, и с передающими спутниками, покрывающими этот регион. Мы бы хотели, чтобы вы проверили объект.

content.original: I don't like the sound of this, Commander. No satellite coverage means no topographical intel. We're going into an unknown situation without a map.
content.prevOriginal: I don't like the sound of this, Commander. No satellite coverage means no topographical intel. We're going into an unknown situation without a map.
content.content: Ох не нравится мне это, командир. Отсутствие спутникового покрытия означает отсутствие топографической информации. Мы идем в неизвестность, без карты.

content.original: Destroy the Facility
content.prevOriginal: Destroy the Facility
content.content: Уничтожьте объект

content.original: Destroy Facility Defenders
content.prevOriginal: Destroy Facility Defenders
content.content: Уничтожьте защитников объекта

content.original: HIDDEN Objective: Destroy Base Turrets
content.prevOriginal: HIDDEN Objective: Destroy Base Turrets
content.content: HIDDEN Objective: уничтожить турели базы

content.original: Destroy {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Reinforcements
content.prevOriginal: Destroy {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Reinforcements
content.content: Уничтожьте подкрепления {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}

content.original: Get to the evac zone
content.prevOriginal: Get to the evac zone
content.content: Доберитесь до зоны эвакуации

content.original: The objective to destroy the targeted buildings.
content.prevOriginal: The objective to destroy the targeted buildings.
content.content: Цель - уничтожение указанных зданий.

content.original: The primary objective to destroy the garrison / defenders of the base.
content.prevOriginal: The primary objective to destroy the garrison / defenders of the base.
content.content: Основная задача - уничтожить гарнизон/защитников базы.

content.original: HIDDEN Objective: Destroy Base Turrets
content.prevOriginal: HIDDEN Objective: Destroy Base Turrets
content.content: HIDDEN Objective: уничтожить турели базы

content.original: The objective to eliminate enemy reinforcements who attack.
content.prevOriginal: The objective to eliminate enemy reinforcements who attack.
content.content: Задача - устранить атакующие подкрепления противника.

content.original: The objective for the player to extract their units.
content.prevOriginal: The objective for the player to extract their units.
content.content: Задача игрока - вывести свои юниты.

content.original: Boss, there's a garbage signal blasting out of that base's transmitters. Want me to put it through?
content.prevOriginal: Boss, there's a garbage signal blasting out of that base's transmitters. Want me to put it through?
content.content: Босс, из передатчиков этой базы доносится какой-то сигнал. Мне пропустить его?

content.original: NO! Do not let it through! Commander, I suspect the signal contains some kind of virus that caused the facility to go offline.
content.prevOriginal: NO! Do not let it through! Commander, I suspect the signal contains some kind of virus that caused the facility to go offline.
content.content: НЕТ! Не пропускайте его! Командир, я подозреваю, что сигнал содержит какой-то вирус, из-за которого весь комплекс и отключился.

content.original: That could also explain the satellite failures. Okay, people, don't answer any calls from outside our secure comms.
content.prevOriginal: That could also explain the satellite failures. Okay, people, don't answer any calls from outside our secure comms.
content.content: Это также может объяснить сбои в работе спутников. Ладно, народ, не отвечайте ни на какие вызовы вне нашего защищенного канала.

content.original: Commander, Darius: if I'm right, that base will need to be completely destroyed.
content.prevOriginal: Commander, Darius: if I'm right, that base will need to be completely destroyed.
content.content: Командир. Насколько я понимаю, базу нужно уничтожить полностью.

content.original: Acknowledged, Dr. Murad. Commander, once you've dealt with the base, Meyer will be on station to pick you up at this LZ.
content.prevOriginal: Acknowledged, Dr. Murad. Commander, once you've dealt with the base, Meyer will be on station to pick you up at this LZ.
content.content: Принято, доктор Мурад. Командир, как только вы разберетесь с базой, Мейер будет на месте и заберет вас с этой базы.

content.original: I wonder if {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} intended this to happen, or if they were themselves infected?
content.prevOriginal: I wonder if {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} intended this to happen, or if they were themselves infected?
content.content: Мне вот интересно, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} хотели, чтобы это произошло, и не заразились ли они сами?

content.original: As long as we've wiped out all traces of that signal, I'm not sure I care.
content.prevOriginal: As long as we've wiped out all traces of that signal, I'm not sure I care.
content.content: Если мы сотрем все следы этого сигнала, то мне все равно.

content.original: I'd be quite surprised if we never saw that signal again, Darius. It's like bedbugs: the sort of thing that you never quite eradicate.
content.prevOriginal: I'd be quite surprised if we never saw that signal again, Darius. It's like bedbugs: the sort of thing that you never quite eradicate.
content.content: Я буду удивлена, Дариус, если мы больше никогда не встретим этот сигнал. Это как с клопами: мелкая зараза, которую никогда полностью не искоренить.

content.original: We need to pull out and alert our employers about this situation. Containing this signal is their problem, now.
content.prevOriginal: We need to pull out and alert our employers about this situation. Containing this signal is their problem, now.
content.content: Нужно отступить и предупредить наших работодателей об этой ситуации. Сдерживание этого сигнала - теперь их забота.

content.original: Picking up some 'Mech signatures. Looks like {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} livery.
content.prevOriginal: Picking up some 'Mech signatures. Looks like {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} livery.
content.content: Засёк сигнатуры мехов. Цвета {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}.

content.original: Commander, with comms switched off, I have no idea if the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are part of an attack, or additional victims of the signal.
content.prevOriginal: Commander, with comms switched off, I have no idea if the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are part of an attack, or additional victims of the signal.
content.content: Командир, поскольку связь отключена, я не знаю, являются ли силы {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} частью атаки или еще одними жертвами сигнала.

content.original: Listen, XO, all due respect, but they're shooting at our damn 'Mechs. Who cares why? Waste 'em.
content.prevOriginal: Listen, XO, all due respect, but they're shooting at our damn 'Mechs. Who cares why? Waste 'em.
content.content: Послушайте, старпом, при всем моем уважении - они стреляют по нашим грёбаным мехам. Какая разница, почему? В расход их.

content.original: As odd as this sounds... I agree with Mr. Virtanen. Anything that was exposed to that signal needs to be completely destroyed.
content.prevOriginal: As odd as this sounds... I agree with Mr. Virtanen. Anything that was exposed to that signal needs to be completely destroyed.
content.content: Как бы странно это ни звучало... соглашусь с мистером Виртаненом. Всё, что подверглось воздействию этого сигнала, должно быть полностью уничтожено.

content.original: We've demolished the objective buildings. No need to loiter, get to the evac zone.
content.prevOriginal: We've demolished the objective buildings. No need to loiter, get to the evac zone.
content.content: Мы разрушили целевые здания. Не стоит мешкать, отправляйтесь в зону эвакуации.

content.original: Good shots, Commander! You scored a solid hit on one of the target structures, keep it up.
content.prevOriginal: Good shots, Commander! You scored a solid hit on one of the target structures, keep it up.
content.content: Хорошая стрельба, командир! Минус одно здание. Продолжайте в том же духе.

content.original: Target building destroyed, good work commander, stay at it and we'll be done in no time.
content.prevOriginal: Target building destroyed, good work commander, stay at it and we'll be done in no time.
content.content: Целевое здание уничтожено, хорошая работа, командир, продолжайте в том же духе, и мы быстро закончим.

content.original: Bkt_KillConfirmed: The garrison is destroyed. Good Work.
content.prevOriginal: Bkt_KillConfirmed: The garrison is destroyed. Good Work.
content.content: Bkt_KillConfirmed: Гарнизон уничтожен. Хорошая работа.

content.original: Deniable Destruction
content.prevOriginal: Deniable Destruction
content.content: Непричастное разрушение

content.original: We are looking for a mercenary company to do some covert work for us. We've lost a base to {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}, and believe {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} personnel are being interrogated even now. We can't allow those people to spill their secrets, but it would look bad if we were seen to destroy our own base. We need deniability. We need you to level the base, particularly the storage and communications facilities. We'd appreciate it if you ensured there were no living witnesses, and will pay a bonus if you wipe out all the opposition.[WARNING: Zombies]
content.prevOriginal: We are looking for a mercenary company to do some covert work for us. content.content: Мы ищем компанию наемников для выполнения секретной работы для нас. Мы потеряли базу {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}, и полагаем, что персонал {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} прямо сейчас допрашивают. Мы не можем позволить тем людям выдать наши секреты, но будет плохо выглядеть, если нас увидят за уничтожением собственной базы. Наша непричастность должна быть неоспорима. Нам нужно, чтобы вы сравняли базу с землей, особенно хранилища и средства связи. Мы будем благодарны, если вы позаботитесь о том, чтобы не осталось живых свидетелей, и заплатим премию, если вы уничтожите всю оппозицию.

content.original: A routine sweep of the planet's surface revealed something unexpected: a power signature coming from the location of an abandoned facility. From the readings we're getting, it could be a 'Mech factory powering up. We're not in a good strategic position to claim the factory, so we need you to find it and destroy it. If we act quickly, we can deal with this before any 'Mechs are produced. If you do come across any newly produced 'Mechs, of course, you should reduce them to scrap as well.[WARNING: Zombies]

Судя по получаемым данным, это может быть запуск завода мехов. Стратегически, этот завод расположен очень неудобно для нашей группы захвата, поэтому нам нужно, чтобы его уничтожили вы. Если действовать быстро, то вы справитесь со всем ещё до того, как первый мех сойдёт с конвеера. Если вы всё же встретите новых мехов, их, конечно, следует превратить обратно в металлолом.

content.prevOriginal: Eject, MechWarrior. NOW. That's an order!
content.content: Катапультируйся, мехвоин. СЕЙЧАС ЖЕ. Это приказ!

content.original: Now come for me, Victoria… your teacher is waiting. Come and show me what you've learned.
content.prevOriginal: Now come for me, Victoria… your teacher is waiting. Come and show me what you've learned.
content.content: Now come for me, Victoria… your teacher is waiting. Come and show me what you've learned.

content.content: It's over, Kamea. Your ascendency… the Arano legacy… all of it.

content.original: Victoria… what have you done?!
content.prevOriginal: Victoria… what have you done?!
content.content: Виктория... что ты наделала?!

content.original: …You know, Kamea… for years, I loved you like a sister. But then my father helped me see it. Your family's complacency. What it's done to the Reach. Our nation dwindles like a dying star, and House Arano is to blame.

content.prevOriginal: Damn it, Victoria, I taught you better than this!
content.content: Damn it, Victoria, I taught you better than this!

content.original: You taught me lies! Kamea, for the love that I once bore you, I'm going to give you a chance to surrender. I'll even spare the old man and his MechWarrior if you stand down now. I don't want to see you hurt, but you cannot be allowed to rule.

This is it, the ultimate challenge. No fluff, no lore, just death. If you ever wanted to fight a mountain, this is your chance. Drop in against the Rattler, a 10,000 ton moving mountain complete with enough firepower to shoot down WarShips from orbit overhead and more armor than your entire company combined. If you think you can take it down, then you're welcome to try. The Word of Blake will not spare you the rod on this contract. If you win, if it's even possible, then the ultimate prize awaits you. Good luck, Commander, you're gonna need it.

THIS CONTRACT IS ABSURDLY HARD, POSSIBLY IMPOSSIBLE. PREPARE FOR INSANE COMBAT FROM THE SECOND YOU LAND. YOU HAVE BEEN WARNED, HEED THE WARNING.

IF YOU BRING TANKS TO THIS MISSION THEY CAN BUG OUT ON CONTRACT COMPLETION AND YOU MIGHT LOSE THEM PERMANENTLY. YOU HAVE BEEN WARNED.

Вот оно, высшее испытание. Ничего лишнего, никакого лора, только смерть. Если вы когда-нибудь хотели сразиться с горой, то - это ваш шанс. Сразитесь с «Крысоловом», 10 000-тонной движущейся горой, обладающей достаточной огневой мощью, чтобы сбивать военные корабли с орбиты, и броней, превышающей броню всех ваших мехов вместе взятых. Если вы думаете, что сможете его уничтожить, то - дерзайте. Слово Блейка не пощадит вас в этом контракте. Если вы победите, если это вообще возможно, то вас ждёт высшая награда. Удачи, командир, она вам понадобится.

Two of our most experienced MechWarriors have for undisclosed reasons decided to betray us and switched sides to {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}. This was not a problem in itself, as we could just hunt them down later. However! They took two of most prized 'Mechs with them, a pair of Superheavys we had just received from the factory. content.original: Due to a very old agreement, predating even the Star League, if called upon a duel for the control of {TGT_SYSTEM.name} has to be fought. But {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} think they have found a loophole, as the contract only specifies the duel is to be fought with two mechs per side within a month of the challenge. As the agreement is not specifying any limits, they have decided to bring two Superheavy 'Mechs, knowing that we can't procure any in time for the deadline. For this reason we have contacted you, Commander {COMMANDER.Name}, we need your company's help to defend the system.

content.original:
Commander {COMMANDER.Name}, thanks to some excellent work by our intelligence division we were able to capture a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} convoy transporting a large amount of valuable raw materials. These raw materials would be used in the processing plants and factories to further their economic control in the sector, which is not acceptable. By capturing these materials, they will instead allow us to once and for all seize economic control and oust the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} presence.

However, there is a small issue of an enemy force trying to intercept the captured vehicles, so we require your assistance guarding the convoy until they can escape. According to your reputation, this type of mission should be fairly straightforward for you and yours, so we expect an efficient and timely execution.. If the mission is concluded in a satisfactory manner we will present more contract offers to you in the future. Oh, also, apparently the convoy is guarded by several Superheavy 'Mechs.

Это сырье предназначалось для их заводов и фабрик и усилило бы их экономический контроль в секторе, что недопустимо. Захватив эти материалы, мы можем раз и навсегда захватить контроль и вытеснить {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}.

Но есть небольшая проблема, связанная с тем, что вражеские силы могут попытаться перехватить захваченный транспорт, поэтому нам требуется ваша помощь в охране конвоя, пока они не сбегут. Судя по вашей репутации, подобная миссия должна быть довольно простой для вас и ваших сотрудников, поэтому мы ожидаем эффективного и своевременного выполнения. Если миссия будет выполнена успешно, мы представим вам более выгодные предложения в будущем. И ещё, судя по всему, конвой охраняют несколько сверхтяжелых мехов.

content.original: A while back one of our convoys on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} was brutally assaulted by a large force including superheavy units. During the attack one of our top scientists went missing and we have tried to locate them ever since. It turns out a local pirate gang has built a hidden base on the planet, and are forcing our scientist to improve their technology. We need to to quickly strike their base and rescue the scientist, and make sure to not leave a single one of those scums alive.
content.prevOriginal:
Sender: MRB Representative of {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}
Recipient: Commander {COMMANDER.LastName} of Mercenary Outfit {COMPANY.CompanyName}
Subject: Available Contract


Primary Objective: The primary objective of this contract is to undertake a rescue operation to retrieve a high-value target (VIP) who has been unlawfully detained as a hostage by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces.

Secondary Objective: The secondary objective entails the retrieval of a briefcase known to have be in the possession of the VIP, which contains highly classified information crucial to our client's interests.

Mission Details: The Mercenary Outfit is to deploy a specialized team comprising of skilled MechWarriors, tacticians, and support personnel for the execution of the rescue mission. The team must infiltrate the enemy-held territory, locate the VIP's whereabouts, and execute a swift and decisive extraction, prioritizing the safety and survival of the VIP over the retrieval of the briefcase.

Threat Assessment: The target location is anticipated to be heavily fortified, requiring the deployment of advanced combat strategies and tactics. Intelligence suggests the presence of active enemy patrols and potentially several superheavy units. The Mercenary Outfit must be prepared for both conventional and asymmetrical threats.

Rules of Engagement: The Mercenary Outfit is authorized to utilize all necessary means to achieve the mission objectives, including but not limited to, armed engagement, stealth tactics, and diplomatic negotiations where applicable. Preservation of the VIP's life is of utmost priority, with the retrieval of the briefcase considered a secondary objective.

Timeline: The contract specifies a strict timeline for the completion of the rescue operation. The Mercenary Outfit must execute the mission within the designated timeframe to ensure the safety and timely extraction of the VIP, with efforts made to retrieve the briefcase only if feasible within the operational parameters.

Compensation: Upon successful completion of the main objective, the Mercenary Outfit will be entitled to a pre-negotiated financial and salvage share compensation, including bonuses for exceptional performance and adherence to mission parameters. Additional compensation may be provided for the fulfillment of the secondary objective, subject to the discretion of the client.

Confidentiality: All aspects of this contract, including mission details, client identity, and operational information, are classified as confidential. The Mercenary Outfit must exercise discretion and maintain strict confidentiality throughout the duration of the contract.

Contract Terms: The terms of this contract are legally binding and are subject to negotiation and agreement between the client and the Mercenary Outfit. Any deviations from the agreed-upon terms must be documented and mutually approved in writing by both parties.


Client Authorization Code: [MRB-SC-4876-936-5618-D]
content.content: Некоторое время назад один из наших конвоев на {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} был жестоко атакован крупными силами, включая сверхтяжелые юниты. Во время нападения пропал один из наших ведущих учёных, и с тех пор мы пытаемся найти его. Оказалось, что местная пиратская банда построила на планете тайную базу и заставляет нашего учёного совершенствовать свои технологии. content.original:
Greetings, Commander {COMMANDER.Name}. We understand that {COMPANY.CompanyName} are available for hire and would like to offer you an opportunity to take part of a very lucrative operation. We are willing to reimburse you quite well if you successfully complete all the objectives.

Your task is to perform a large assault on the light defense of a remote rare minerals mine controlled by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}. The key is to show up with a enough forces that the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} defenders will call for backup. This allows us, once the defenders are lured away, to land a secondary strike team a considerably distance away with the goal of destroying their major manufacturing plants in the region Taking them out will lower the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} industrial potential greatly, allowing us to lay the foundation for an economic victory in the whole sector.

If you time it correctly, you might even be finished taking out their local defenders at the mine before the reinforcements arrive, we leave it to up to you to leave before they arrive or not, but we do recommend it as they field several Superheavy units on the planet.

content.content:
Приветствую, командир {COMMANDER.Name}. Мы так понимаем, {COMPANY.CompanyName} доступны для найма и хотели бы предложить вам возможность принять участие в очень прибыльной операции. Мы готовы хорошо возместить вам расходы, если вы успешно выполните все задачи.

Ваша задача — провести крупномасштабный штурм слабо обороняемой отдалённой шахты по добыче редких минералов, контролируемой {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}. Главное — появиться с достаточным количеством сил, чтобы защитники {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} вызвали подкрепление. Это позволит нам, как только защитники будут отвлечены, высадить другой ударный отряд в другом месте с целью уничтожения их основных производственных предприятий в регионе. Их уничтожение значительно снизит промышленный потенциал {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}, что позволит нам заложить основу для экономической победы во всем секторе.

Если вы правильно рассчитаете время, вы даже сможете уничтожить их местных защитников на шахте до прибытия подкрепления. Мы оставляем на ваше усмотрение, уйти до их прибытия или нет, но мы рекомендуем отступить, поскольку у них на планете имеется несколько сверхтяжелых юнитов.

content.original: Sounds like a plan, let's drop near the mine and surprise attack them before quickly leaving.

content.content: Звучит заманчиво, давайте высадимся возле шахты и внезапно нападем на них, а затем быстро уберёмся.

content.original: Commande {COMMANDER.NAME}, I approach you with a beneficial offer for us both. A {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Superheavy 'Mech keeps harassing our convoys, but we don't have the manpower to handle it right now. If you could deal with the threat for us, you get to keep whatever remains or falls off it. We already know the sector the 'Mech can be found in, so if you take off immediately you should be able to catch it.

We would like you to deal with this 'Mech for us, what you do with it is up to you after that.

Во время нападения пропал один из наших ведущих учёных, и с тех пор мы пытаемся найти его. Оказалось, что местная пиратская банда построила на планете тайную базу и заставляет нашего учёного совершенствовать свои технологии. Нам нужно быстро нанести удар по их базе и спасти учёного, а также позаботиться о том, чтобы не оставить в живых ни одного из этих подонков. Переведено с помощью DeepL.com (бесплатная версия)

content.original:
Greetings, Commander {COMMANDER.Name}. We'd like to hire the {COMPANY.CompanyName} for a top secret mission. We have recently obtained the full blueprints of a Military Complex, including a hidden {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} command bunker deep underground claimed to be the location of the sector HQ. The bunker is so far underground that a normal attack will not be able to reach them, so instead our plan is to destroy all entrances to the bunker, effectively sealing them in.

We need you to find three key locations from the blueprint, and mark them for a long range orbital barrage. You will have to be prepared to deal with some of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}'s strongest units on defense, including superheavies. We recommend completing the mission as fast as you can, otherwise chances are high that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Response Teams will have time to arrive.

The bunker is so far underground that a normal attack will not be able to reach them, so instead our plan is to destroy all entrances to the bunker, effectively sealing them in.

We need you to find three key locations from the blueprint, and mark them for a long range orbital barrage. You will have to be prepared to deal with some of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}'s strongest units on defense, including superheavies. We recommend completing the mission as fast as you can, otherwise chances are high that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Response Teams will have time to arrive.
content.content:
Командир {COMMANDER.Name}, приветствуем вас. Мы хотели бы нанять {COMPANY.CompanyName} для выполнения сверхсекретного задания. Недавно мы получили полные чертежи военного комплекса, включая скрытый под землей командный бункер {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}, в котором, как утверждается, находится центр управления этим сектором. Бункер находится так далеко под землей, что обычная атака не сможет добраться до него, поэтому наш план состоит в том, чтобы уничтожить все входы в бункер, фактически запечатав их.

 Нам нужно, чтобы вы нашли три ключевых места из чертежа и отметили их для дальнего орбитального обстрела. Вы должны быть готовы к тому, что оборона будет состоять из самых сильных юнитов {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}, включая сверхтяжей. Мы рекомендуем завершить миссию как можно быстрее, иначе велика вероятность того, что группы реагирования {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} успеют перехватить вас.

content.original: Well, we now know what Bearing has been up to while away from us.  This is essentially an observation mission, so none of our assets will be at risk.  By the same token, we cannot get any salvage either, but perhaps Bearing will want to rejoin us when this is over.

content.original: There's a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} convoy loaded with stolen weaponry belonging to Great Shotz, a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} funded company. They have been attempting to fight off the ever increasing raids, but the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} leadership has employed a highly-skilled professional mercenary to protect the convoy's route and will intercept any attackers. Being highly-skilled professionals yourselves, we thought perhaps you could pay a visit to this hired gun -- and destroy the convoy while you're at it. We will send in a recovery crew to retrieve as much of the stolen gear as possible.

content.original: Commander, one of our facilities has gone dark, and we're not sure why. The facility is one of two Bergan Industries manufacturing plants in the region. We have satellite imagery showing unknown 'Mechs moving in the area, and it seems as though they're preparing for an assault on the secondary supply depot as well. We need you to put 'Mechs in the field, defend the secondary supply depot, and drive them out of the primary manufacturing plant. Our own forces are inbound but won't get there in time to save the secondary supply depot.

Нам нужно, чтобы вы отправили мехов, защитили склад снабжения и вытеснили их с завода. Наши силы уже на подходе, но они не успеют спасти склад.
