content.original: Commander, we're tasked with neutralizing a facility that's been captured by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} corporate terrorists.
content.prevOriginal: Commander, we're tasked with neutralizing a facility that's been captured by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} corporate terrorists.
content.content: Commander, we're tasked with neutralizing a facility that's been captured by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} corporate terrorists.

content.original: Before we get there, however, you'll need to intercept the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance closing on our position.
content.prevOriginal: Before we get there, however, you'll need to intercept the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance closing on our position.
content.content: Однако прежде, чем мы доберемся туда, вам потребуется перехватить отряд {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}, идущий на нас.

content.original: We'll have some backup in the form of defensive turrets, but they won't last long against actual 'Mechs. You'll need to make sure to keep the enemy's attention, or they'll destroy the Bergan Industries Supply Depot.
content.prevOriginal: We'll have some backup in the form of defensive turrets, but they won't last long against actual 'Mechs. You'll need to make sure to keep the enemy's attention, or they'll destroy the Bergan Industries Supply Depot.
content.content: We'll have some backup in the form of defensive turrets, but they won't last long against actual 'Mechs. You'll need to make sure to keep the enemy's attention, or they'll destroy the Bergan Industries Supply Depot.

content.original: The only way to stop the attacks entirely is to break their command and control -- which means removing their control of the captured facility. That should be your priority.
content.prevOriginal: The only way to stop the attacks entirely is to break their command and control -- which means removing their control of the captured facility. That should be your priority.
content.content: The only way to stop the attacks entirely is to break their command and control -- which means removing their control of the captured facility. That should be your priority.

content.original: I'll be on station, Commander. Once that base is neutralized, I'll meet you at this LZ.
content.prevOriginal: I'll be on station, Commander. Once that base is neutralized, I'll meet you at this LZ.
content.content: I'll be on station, Commander. Once that base is neutralized, I'll meet you at this LZ.

content.original: That's it; let's pack it up, folks. Commander, we'll debrief back in orbit.
content.prevOriginal: That's it; let's pack it up, folks. Commander, we'll debrief back in orbit.
content.content: На этом всё; сворачиваемся, народ. Командир, разбор полётов — уже на орбите.

content.original: Well, that didn't go as planned. Let's debrief back on the Argo, Commander.
content.prevOriginal: Well, that didn't go as planned. Let's debrief back on the Argo, Commander.
content.content: Что ж, всё пошло по одному месту. Давайте обсудим произошедшее на борту «Арго», командир.

content.original: There's those facility defenses, Commander. Looks like the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces got the defense turrets powered up.
content.prevOriginal: There's those facility defenses, Commander. Looks like the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces got the defense turrets powered up.
content.content: There's those facility defenses, Commander. Looks like the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} forces got the defense turrets powered up.

content.original: Commander, I'm seeing hostile defenders surrounding the captured facility.
content.prevOriginal: Commander, I'm seeing hostile defenders surrounding the captured facility.
content.content: Commander, I'm seeing hostile defenders surrounding the captured facility.

content.original: We can't complete the contract until those units are destroyed.
content.prevOriginal: We can't complete the contract until those units are destroyed.
content.content: Мы не сможем завершить контракт, пока эти юниты не будут уничтожены.

content.original: Commander, they've got units spread out around the target facility. If we clean them out, our employers won't have to; they're offering a bonus. It's your call.
content.prevOriginal: Commander, they've got units spread out around the target facility. If we clean them out, our employers won't have to; they're offering a bonus. It's your call.
content.content: Командир, у них юниты рассредоточены вокруг целевого объекта. Если мы от них избавимся, то нашим работодателям не придётся с ними возиться; они предлагают премию. Решать вам.

content.original: That's the first target structure neutralised, Commander. Keep up the pressure.
content.prevOriginal: That's the first target structure neutralised, Commander. Keep up the pressure.
content.content: That's the first target structure neutralised, Commander. Keep up the pressure.

content.original: Argo, our supply depot is taking fire over here. We need you to draw that fire off, or we're dead!
content.prevOriginal: Argo, our supply depot is taking fire over here. We need you to draw that fire off, or we're dead!
content.content: Argo, our supply depot is taking fire over here. We need you to draw that fire off, or we're dead!

content.original: Argo, we've lost one of our structures. You've got to move faster, or we'll lose them all!
content.prevOriginal: Argo, we've lost one of our structures. You've got to move faster, or we'll lose them all!
content.content: Арго, мы потеряли одно из наших строений. Вы должны ускориться, или мы потеряем их все!

content.original: Argo, we're under heavy-- [static]-- hold out-- [static]
content.prevOriginal: Argo, we're under heavy-- [static]-- hold out-- [static]
content.content: Арго, мы под тяжелым... [помехи]... продержаться... [помехи]

content.original: Dammit! Commander, we've only got one building left. If it goes down, we're scrubbing the contract.
content.prevOriginal: Dammit! Commander, we've only got one building left. If it goes down, we're scrubbing the contract.
content.content: Вашу мать, командир! У нас осталось всего одно здание. Если оно рухнет, мы аннулируем контракт.

content.original: Boom! Good kill, boss!
content.prevOriginal: Boom! Good kill, boss!
content.content: Бум! Хорош, босс!

content.original: Meyer, cut the chatter and get ready for the pickup.
content.prevOriginal: Meyer, cut the chatter and get ready for the pickup.
content.content: Мейер, довольно болтовни, готовься подобрать нас.

content.original: Commander, we've completed all the primary objectives and you're clear to extract.
content.prevOriginal: Commander, we've completed all the primary objectives and you're clear to extract.
content.content: Командир, мы выполнили все основные задачи, вы можете уходить.

content.original: I'm on station to pick you up here whenever you're ready, boss.
content.prevOriginal: I'm on station to pick you up here whenever you're ready, boss.
content.content: Я на месте, заберу вас по вашей готовности, босс.

content.original: As long as you're still in the AO, Commander, you'll need to keep the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} depot secure.
content.prevOriginal: As long as you're still in the AO, Commander, you'll need to keep the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} depot secure.
content.content: As long as you're still in the AO, Commander, you'll need to keep the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} depot secure.

content.original: Uh, Commander, I'm not seeing any more blips out there. I think you killed everything.
content.prevOriginal: Uh, Commander, I'm not seeing any more blips out there. I think you killed everything.
content.content: Э-э, командир, больше никаких отметок на радаре. Похоже, вы там уничтожили ВСЁ.

content.original: Well, that's one way to protect a facility. Commander, there's a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} lance ready to relieve you.
content.prevOriginal: Well, that's one way to protect a facility. Commander, there's a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} lance ready to relieve you.
content.content: Что ж, это один из способов защитить объект. Командир, отряд {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} готов вас сменить.

content.original: When you're ready to extract, Sumire will pick you up at this location.
content.prevOriginal: When you're ready to extract, Sumire will pick you up at this location.
content.content: Когда будете готовы уходить, Сумир заберет вас в этой точке.

content.original: Heads up, commander, a lance of {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} units just entered the area. They're hostile to everyone!
content.prevOriginal: Heads up, commander, a lance of {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} units just entered the area. They're hostile to everyone!
content.content: Внимание, командир, отряд {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Name} только что вошёл в зону. Они враждебны ко всем!

content.original: We'll have to destroy that lance if we want to complete the mission.
content.prevOriginal: We'll have to destroy that lance if we want to complete the mission.
content.content: Нам придется уничтожить этот отряд, если мы хотим завершить миссию.

content.original: Heads up, commander, a lance of {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} units just entered the area. They're hostile to everyone!
content.prevOriginal: Heads up, commander, a lance of {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} units just entered the area. They're hostile to everyone!
content.content: Внимание, командир, отряд {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Name} только что вошёл в зону. Они враждебны ко всем!

content.original: If we destroy them we'll get a hefty bonus.
content.prevOriginal: If we destroy them we'll get a hefty bonus.
content.content: Если мы уничтожим их, то получим большую премию.

content.original: Commander, I'm seeing hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} units in the area. Our target brought in allies for backup.
content.prevOriginal: Commander, I'm seeing hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} units in the area. Our target brought in allies for backup.
content.content: Командир, я вижу враждебные юниты {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Name} в этом районе. Наша цель привела дружков в помощь.

content.original: Our employer is saying we NEED to kill those units. Prepare to engage.
content.prevOriginal: Our employer is saying we NEED to kill those units. Prepare to engage.
content.content: Наш наниматель говорит, что мы ДОЛЖНЫ убить эти юниты. Готовьтесь к бою.

content.original: Hostage Rescue
content.prevOriginal: Hostage Rescue
content.content: Спасение заложников

content.original: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} Medical DropShip ferrying casualties from a major offensive was attacked by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces and crippled.  It was forced to land behind enemy lines on [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]].  It appears crew and patients on board were taken captive by a heavily armed {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} force.  We don't have an available in-system military presence large enough to mount a hostage rescue mission, so we're looking for a competent mercenary company to do it. We need you to reach the facility where the crew is being held, destroy the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units guarding them, and escort them to safety.

content.content: Медицинский корабль {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}, перевозивший раненых во время крупного нападения, был атакован силами {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} и разбит. Он был вынужден приземлиться в тылу врага на [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]]. Похоже, что экипаж и пациенты на борту были взяты в плен хорошо вооруженными силами {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}. У нас нет достаточных военных сил в системе, чтобы организовать миссию по освобождению заложников, поэтому мы ищем компетентную компанию наёмников, которая сможет это сделать. Нам нужно, чтобы вы добрались до объекта, где удерживается экипаж, уничтожили охраняющие его силы {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} и сопроводили людей в безопасное место.

content.original: I'm getting radio chatter from the facility, Commander. It sounds like the crew has staged an uprising.
content.prevOriginal: I'm getting radio chatter from the facility, Commander. It sounds like the crew has staged an uprising.
content.content: Я получаю радиопереговоры с объекта, командир. Похоже, что персонал поднял восстание.

content.original: We need to get to their location and secure the area so they can make their escape.
content.prevOriginal: We need to get to their location and secure the area so they can make their escape.
content.content: Мы должны добраться до их местонахождения и оцепить территорию, чтобы они могли сбежать.

content.original: Expect serious resistance, now that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are alert for a rescue attempt.
content.prevOriginal: Expect serious resistance, now that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are alert for a rescue attempt.
content.content: Теперь ожидайте серьезное сопротивление, раз силы {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} оповещены о попытке спасения.

content.original: The crew is safely back in orbit, Commander. Well done.
content.prevOriginal: The crew is safely back in orbit, Commander. Well done.
content.content: Экипаж благополучно вернулся на орбиту, командир. Отличная работа.

content.original: Dammit. That fell apart in a hurry. Let's debrief back in orbit, Commander.
content.prevOriginal: Dammit. That fell apart in a hurry. Let's debrief back in orbit, Commander.
content.content: Проклятье. Как-то быстро всё развалилось. Давайте проведём разбор полётов на корабле, командир.

content.original: Commander. The enemy has deployed reinforcements and they are inbound. Expect increased resistance.
content.prevOriginal: Commander. The enemy has deployed reinforcements and they are inbound. Expect increased resistance.
content.content: Командир. Противник вызвал подкрепление, и оно приближается. Ожидайте повышенное сопротивление.

content.original: More contacts on the sensors, Commander. They're moving to intercept the escaping hostages.
content.prevOriginal: More contacts on the sensors, Commander. They're moving to intercept the escaping hostages.
content.content: Еще больше контактов на сенсорах, командир. Они движутся на перехват бегущих заложников.

content.original: You've reached the extraction point for the objective vehicles. Hold there are keep them safe until we can get them out.
content.prevOriginal: You've reached the extraction point for the objective vehicles. Hold there are keep them safe until we can get them out.
content.content: Вы достигли точки эвакуации транспортных средств. Оставайтесь там и обеспечивайте их безопасность, пока мы не заберём их.

content.original: Looks like the crew has seized some light vehicles to make their escape. We'll need to run interference for them till they reach their pickup point.
content.prevOriginal: Looks like the crew has seized some light vehicles to make their escape. We'll need to run interference for them till they reach their pickup point.
content.content: Похоже, команда захватила несколько легких транспортных средств, чтобы совершить побег. Мы должны послужить им щитом, пока они не достигнут точки сбора.

content.original: Keep in mind that the convoy will try to stay near you for protection. Continue advancing to get them to the extract point!
content.prevOriginal: Keep in mind that the convoy will try to stay near you for protection. Continue advancing to get them to the extract point!
content.content: Имейте в виду, что конвой будет стараться оставаться рядом с вами для защиты. Продвигайтесь и вместе доберитесь до точки эвакуации.

content.original: And they are away! The convoy is safely out of the AO. Good work, Commander. Now get your remaining forces to the second evac zone for extraction there.
content.prevOriginal: And they are away! The convoy is safely out of the AO. Good work, Commander. Now get your remaining forces to the second evac zone for extraction there.
content.content: Ну вот и все! Конвой благополучно покинул зону операции. Хорошая работа, командир. Теперь направьте оставшиеся силы во вторую зону эвакуации, пора уходить отсюда.

content.original: Hostage Rescue
content.prevOriginal: Hostage Rescue
content.content: Спасение заложников

content.original: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} Medical DropShip ferrying casualties from a major offensive was attacked by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces and crippled.  It was forced to land behind enemy lines on [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]].  It appears crew and patients on board were taken captive by a heavily armed {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} force.  We don't have an available in-system military presence large enough to mount a hostage rescue mission, so we're looking for a competent mercenary company to do it. We need you to reach the facility where the crew is being held, destroy the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units guarding them, and escort them to safety.
content.prevOriginal: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} Medical DropShip ferrying casualties from a major offensive was attacked by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces and crippled. We need you to reach the facility where the crew is being held, destroy the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units guarding them, and escort them to safety.
content.content: Медицинский корабль {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}, перевозивший раненых во время крупного нападения, был атакован силами {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} и разбит. Он был вынужден приземлиться в тылу врага на [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]]. Похоже, что экипаж и пациенты на борту были взяты в плен хорошо вооруженными силами {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}. У нас нет достаточных военных сил в системе, чтобы организовать миссию по освобождению заложников, поэтому мы ищем компетентную компанию наёмников, которая сможет это сделать. Нам нужно, чтобы вы добрались до объекта, где удерживается экипаж, уничтожили охраняющие его силы {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} и сопроводили людей в безопасное место.

content.original: Assuming the hostages are still alive, we're going to have a hell of a time keeping them that way.  Our best defense is a good offense so we need to destroy anything that is even remotely a threat to the hostages.  Expect heavy resistance Commander.
content.prevOriginal: Assuming the hostages are still alive, we're going to have a hell of a time keeping them that way.  Our best defense is a good offense so we need to destroy anything that is even remotely a threat to the hostages.  Expect heavy resistance Commander.
content.content: Если предположить, что заложники всё ещё живы, нам будет чертовски трудно не дать им погибнуть. Лучшая защита - это добротное нападение, поэтому нам нужно уничтожить всё, что хотя бы отдалённо представляет угрозу для заложников. Ожидайте сильное сопротивление, командир.

content.original: I'm getting radio chatter from the facility, Commander. It sounds like the crew has staged an uprising.
content.prevOriginal: I'm getting radio chatter from the facility, Commander. It sounds like the crew has staged an uprising.
content.content: Я получаю радиопереговоры с объекта, командир. Похоже, что персонал поднял восстание.

content.original: We need to get to their location and secure the area so they can make their escape.
content.prevOriginal: We need to get to their location and secure the area so they can make their escape.
content.content: Мы должны добраться до их местонахождения и оцепить территорию, чтобы они могли сбежать.

content.original: Expect serious resistance, now that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are alert for a rescue attempt.
content.prevOriginal: Expect serious resistance, now that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are alert for a rescue attempt.
content.content: Теперь ожидайте серьезное сопротивление, раз силы {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} оповещены о попытке спасения.

content.original: The crew is safely back in orbit, Commander. Well done.
content.prevOriginal: The crew is safely back in orbit, Commander. Well done.
content.content: Экипаж благополучно вернулся на орбиту, командир. Отличная работа.

content.original: Dammit. That fell apart in a hurry. Let's debrief back in orbit, Commander.
content.prevOriginal: Dammit. That fell apart in a hurry. Let's debrief back in orbit, Commander.
content.content: Проклятье. Как-то быстро всё развалилось. Давайте проведём разбор полётов на корабле, командир.

content.original: Commander. The enemy has deployed reinforcements and they are inbound. Expect increased resistance.
content.prevOriginal: Commander. The enemy has deployed reinforcements and they are inbound. Expect increased resistance.
content.content: Командир. Противник вызвал подкрепление, и оно приближается. Ожидайте повышенное сопротивление.

content.original: More contacts on the sensors, Commander. They're moving to intercept the escaping hostages.
content.prevOriginal: More contacts on the sensors, Commander. They're moving to intercept the escaping hostages.
content.content: Еще больше контактов на сенсорах, командир. Они движутся на перехват бегущих заложников.

content.original: You've reached the extraction point for the objective vehicles. Hold there are keep them safe until we can get them out.
content.prevOriginal: You've reached the extraction point for the objective vehicles. Hold there are keep them safe until we can get them out.
content.content: Вы достигли точки эвакуации транспортных средств. Оставайтесь там и обеспечивайте их безопасность, пока мы не заберём их.

content.original: Looks like the crew has seized some light vehicles to make their escape. We'll need to run interference for them till they reach their pickup point.
content.prevOriginal: Looks like the crew has seized some light vehicles to make their escape. We'll need to run interference for them till they reach their pickup point.
content.content: Похоже, команда захватила несколько легких транспортных средств, чтобы совершить побег. Мы должны послужить им щитом, пока они не достигнут точки сбора.

content.original: Keep in mind that the convoy will try to stay near you for protection. Continue advancing to get them to the extract point!
content.prevOriginal: Keep in mind that the convoy will try to stay near you for protection. Continue advancing to get them to the extract point!
content.content: Имейте в виду, что конвой будет стараться оставаться рядом с вами для защиты. Продвигайтесь и вместе доберитесь до точки эвакуации.

content.original: And they are away! The convoy is safely out of the AO. Good work, Commander. Now get your remaining forces to the second evac zone for extraction there.
content.prevOriginal: And they are away! The convoy is safely out of the AO. Good work, Commander. Now get your remaining forces to the second evac zone for extraction there.
content.content: Ну вот и все! Конвой благополучно покинул зону операции. Хорошая работа, командир. Теперь направьте оставшиеся силы во вторую зону эвакуации, пора уходить отсюда.

content.original: Hostage Rescue
content.prevOriginal: Hostage Rescue
content.content: Спасение заложников

content.original: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} Medical DropShip ferrying casualties from a major offensive was attacked by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces and crippled.  It was forced to land behind enemy lines on [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]].  It appears crew and patients on board were taken captive by a heavily armed {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} force.  We don't have an available in-system military presence large enough to mount a hostage rescue mission, so we're looking for a competent mercenary company to do it. We need you to reach the facility where the crew is being held, destroy the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units guarding them, and escort them to safety.
content.prevOriginal: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} Medical DropShip ferrying casualties from a major offensive was attacked by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces and crippled.  It was forced to land behind enemy lines on [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]].  It appears crew and patients on board were taken captive by a heavily armed {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} force.  We don't have an available in-system military presence large enough to mount a hostage rescue mission, so we're looking for a competent mercenary company to do it. We need you to reach the facility where the crew is being held, destroy the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units guarding them, and escort them to safety.
content.content: Медицинский корабль {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}, перевозивший раненых во время крупного нападения, был атакован силами {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} и разбит. Он был вынужден приземлиться в тылу врага на [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]]. Похоже, что экипаж и пациенты на борту были взяты в плен хорошо вооруженными силами {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}. У нас нет достаточных военных сил в системе, чтобы организовать миссию по освобождению заложников, поэтому мы ищем компетентную компанию наёмников, которая сможет это сделать. Нам нужно, чтобы вы добрались до объекта, где удерживается экипаж, уничтожили охраняющие его силы {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} и сопроводили людей в безопасное место.

content.original: Assuming the hostages are still alive, we're going to have a hell of a time keeping them that way.  Our best defense is a good offense so we need to destroy anything that is even remotely a threat to the hostages.  Expect heavy resistance Commander.
content.prevOriginal: Assuming the hostages are still alive, we're going to have a hell of a time keeping them that way.  Our best defense is a good offense so we need to destroy anything that is even remotely a threat to the hostages.  Expect heavy resistance Commander.
content.content: Если предположить, что заложники всё ещё живы, нам будет чертовски трудно не дать им погибнуть. Лучшая защита - это добротное нападение, поэтому нам нужно уничтожить всё, что хотя бы отдалённо представляет угрозу для заложников. Ожидайте сильное сопротивление, командир.

content.prevOriginal: I'm getting radio chatter from the facility, Commander. It sounds like the crew has staged an uprising.
content.content: Я получаю радиопереговоры с объекта, командир. Похоже, что персонал поднял восстание.

content.original: We need to get to their location and secure the area so they can make their escape.
content.prevOriginal: We need to get to their location and secure the area so they can make their escape.
content.content: Мы должны добраться до их местонахождения и оцепить территорию, чтобы они могли сбежать.

content.original: Expect serious resistance, now that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are alert for a rescue attempt.
content.prevOriginal: Expect serious resistance, now that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are alert for a rescue attempt.
content.content: Теперь ожидайте серьезное сопротивление, раз силы {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} оповещены о попытке спасения.

content.original: The crew is safely back in orbit, Commander. Well done.
content.prevOriginal: The crew is safely back in orbit, Commander. Well done.
content.content: Экипаж благополучно вернулся на орбиту, командир. Отличная работа.

content.original: Dammit. That fell apart in a hurry. Let's debrief back in orbit, Commander.
content.prevOriginal: Dammit. That fell apart in a hurry. Let's debrief back in orbit, Commander.
content.content: Проклятье. Как-то быстро всё развалилось. Давайте проведём разбор полётов на корабле, командир.

content.original: Commander. The enemy has deployed reinforcements and they are inbound. Expect increased resistance.
content.prevOriginal: Commander. The enemy has deployed reinforcements and they are inbound. Expect increased resistance.
content.content: Командир. Противник вызвал подкрепление, и оно приближается. Ожидайте повышенное сопротивление.

content.original: More contacts on the sensors, Commander. They're moving to intercept the escaping hostages.
content.prevOriginal: More contacts on the sensors, Commander. They're moving to intercept the escaping hostages.
content.content: Еще больше контактов на сенсорах, командир. Они движутся на перехват бегущих заложников.

content.original: You've reached the extraction point for the objective vehicles. Hold there are keep them safe until we can get them out.
content.prevOriginal: You've reached the extraction point for the objective vehicles. Hold there are keep them safe until we can get them out.
content.content: Вы достигли точки эвакуации транспортных средств. Оставайтесь там и обеспечивайте их безопасность, пока мы не заберём их.

content.original: Looks like the crew has seized some light vehicles to make their escape. We'll need to run interference for them till they reach their pickup point.
content.prevOriginal: Looks like the crew has seized some light vehicles to make their escape. We'll need to run interference for them till they reach their pickup point.
content.content: Похоже, команда захватила несколько легких транспортных средств, чтобы совершить побег. Мы должны послужить им щитом, пока они не достигнут точки сбора.

content.original: Keep in mind that the convoy will try to stay near you for protection. Continue advancing to get them to the extract point!
content.prevOriginal: Keep in mind that the convoy will try to stay near you for protection. Continue advancing to get them to the extract point!
content.content: Имейте в виду, что конвой будет стараться оставаться рядом с вами для защиты. Продвигайтесь и вместе доберитесь до точки эвакуации.

content.original: And they are away! The convoy is safely out of the AO. Good work, Commander. Now get your remaining forces to the second evac zone for extraction there.
content.prevOriginal: And they are away! The convoy is safely out of the AO. Good work, Commander. Now get your remaining forces to the second evac zone for extraction there.
content.content: Ну вот и все! Конвой благополучно покинул зону операции. Хорошая работа, командир. Теперь направьте оставшиеся силы во вторую зону эвакуации, пора уходить отсюда.

content.original: Hostage Rescue
content.prevOriginal: Hostage Rescue
content.content: Спасение заложников

content.original: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} Medical DropShip ferrying casualties from a major offensive was attacked by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces and crippled.  It was forced to land behind enemy lines on [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]].  It appears crew and patients on board were taken captive by a heavily armed {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} force.  We don't have an available in-system military presence large enough to mount a hostage rescue mission, so we're looking for a competent mercenary company to do it. We need you to reach the facility where the crew is being held, destroy the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units guarding them, and escort them to safety.
content.prevOriginal: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} Medical DropShip ferrying casualties from a major offensive was attacked by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces and crippled. We need you to reach the facility where the crew is being held, destroy the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units guarding them, and escort them to safety.
content.content: Медицинский корабль {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}, перевозивший раненых во время крупного нападения, был атакован силами {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} и разбит. Он был вынужден приземлиться в тылу врага на [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]]. Похоже, что экипаж и пациенты на борту были взяты в плен хорошо вооруженными силами {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}. У нас нет достаточных военных сил в системе, чтобы организовать миссию по освобождению заложников, поэтому мы ищем компетентную компанию наёмников, которая сможет это сделать. Нам нужно, чтобы вы добрались до объекта, где удерживается экипаж, уничтожили охраняющие его силы {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} и сопроводили людей в безопасное место.

content.original: Assuming the hostages are still alive, we're going to have a hell of a time keeping them that way.  Our best defense is a good offense so we need to destroy anything that is even remotely a threat to the hostages.  Expect heavy resistance Commander.
content.prevOriginal: Assuming the hostages are still alive, we're going to have a hell of a time keeping them that way.  Our best defense is a good offense so we need to destroy anything that is even remotely a threat to the hostages.  Expect heavy resistance Commander.
content.content: Если предположить, что заложники всё ещё живы, нам будет чертовски трудно не дать им погибнуть. Лучшая защита - это добротное нападение, поэтому нам нужно уничтожить всё, что хотя бы отдалённо представляет угрозу для заложников. Ожидайте сильное сопротивление, командир.

content.original: More contacts on the sensors, Commander. They're moving to intercept the escaping hostages.

content.prevOriginal: You've reached the extraction point for the objective vehicles. Hold there are keep them safe until we can get them out.

content.original: Looks like the crew has seized some light vehicles to make their escape. We'll need to run interference for them till they reach their pickup point.
content.prevOriginal: Looks like the crew has seized some light vehicles to make their escape. We'll need to run interference for them till they reach their pickup point.

content.original: Keep in mind that the convoy will try to stay near you for protection. Continue advancing to get them to the extract point!

content.original: And they are away! The convoy is safely out of the AO. Good work, Commander. Now get your remaining forces to the second evac zone for extraction there.
content.prevOriginal: And they are away! The convoy is safely out of the AO. Good work, Commander. Now get your remaining forces to the second evac zone for extraction there.
content.content: Ну вот и все! Конвой благополучно покинул зону операции. Хорошая работа, командир. Теперь направьте оставшиеся силы во вторую зону эвакуации, пора уходить отсюда.

content.original: Hostage Rescue
content.prevOriginal: Hostage Rescue
content.content: Спасение заложников

content.original: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} Medical DropShip ferrying casualties from a major offensive was attacked by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces and crippled.  It was forced to land behind enemy lines on [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]].  It appears crew and patients on board were taken captive by a heavily armed {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} force.  We don't have an available in-system military presence large enough to mount a hostage rescue mission, so we're looking for a competent mercenary company to do it. We need you to reach the facility where the crew is being held, destroy the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units guarding them, and escort them to safety.

content.content: Медицинский корабль {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}, перевозивший раненых во время крупного нападения, был атакован силами {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} и разбит. Он был вынужден приземлиться в тылу врага на [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]]. Похоже, что экипаж и пациенты на борту были взяты в плен хорошо вооруженными силами {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}. У нас нет достаточных военных сил в системе, чтобы организовать миссию по освобождению заложников, поэтому мы ищем компетентную компанию наёмников, которая сможет это сделать. Нам нужно, чтобы вы добрались до объекта, где удерживается экипаж, уничтожили охраняющие его силы {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} и сопроводили людей в безопасное место.

content.original: Assuming the hostages are still alive, we're going to have a hell of a time keeping them that way.  Our best defense is a good offense so we need to destroy anything that is even remotely a threat to the hostages.  Expect heavy resistance Commander.

We don't have an available in-system military presence large enough to mount a hostage rescue mission, so we're looking for a competent mercenary company to do it. We need you to reach the facility where the crew is being held, destroy the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units guarding them, and escort them to safety.

content.content: Медицинский корабль {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}, перевозивший раненых во время крупного нападения, был атакован силами {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} и разбит. Он был вынужден приземлиться в тылу врага на [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]]. Похоже, что экипаж и пациенты на борту были взяты в плен хорошо вооруженными силами {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}. У нас нет достаточных военных сил в системе, чтобы организовать миссию по освобождению заложников, поэтому мы ищем компетентную компанию наёмников, которая сможет это сделать. Нам нужно, чтобы вы добрались до объекта, где удерживается экипаж, уничтожили охраняющие его силы {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} и сопроводили людей в безопасное место.

content.original: Assuming the hostages are still alive, we're going to have a hell of a time keeping them that way.  Our best defense is a good offense so we need to destroy anything that is even remotely a threat to the hostages.  Expect heavy resistance Commander.

content.original: We need to get to their location and secure the area so they can make their escape.

content.original: The crew is safely back in orbit, Commander. Well done.
content.prevOriginal: The crew is safely back in orbit, Commander. Well done.
content.content: Экипаж благополучно вернулся на орбиту, командир. Отличная работа.

content.original: Dammit. That fell apart in a hurry. Let's debrief back in orbit, Commander.
content.prevOriginal: Dammit. That fell apart in a hurry. Let's debrief back in orbit, Commander.
content.content: Проклятье. Как-то быстро всё развалилось. Давайте проведём разбор полётов на корабле, командир.

content.original: Commander. The enemy has deployed reinforcements and they are inbound. Expect increased resistance.
content.prevOriginal: Commander. The enemy has deployed reinforcements and they are inbound. Expect increased resistance.
content.content: Командир. Противник вызвал подкрепление, и оно приближается. Ожидайте повышенное сопротивление.

content.original: More contacts on the sensors, Commander. They're moving to intercept the escaping hostages.
content.prevOriginal: More contacts on the sensors, Commander. They're moving to intercept the escaping hostages.
content.content: Еще больше контактов на сенсорах, командир. Они движутся на перехват бегущих заложников.

content.original: You've reached the extraction point for the objective vehicles. Hold there are keep them safe until we can get them out.
content.prevOriginal: You've reached the extraction point for the objective vehicles. Hold there are keep them safe until we can get them out.
content.content: Вы достигли точки эвакуации транспортных средств. Оставайтесь там и обеспечивайте их безопасность, пока мы не заберём их.

content.original: Looks like the crew has seized some light vehicles to make their escape. We'll need to run interference for them till they reach their pickup point.
content.prevOriginal: Looks like the crew has seized some light vehicles to make their escape. We'll need to run interference for them till they reach their pickup point.
content.content: Похоже, команда захватила несколько легких транспортных средств, чтобы совершить побег. Мы должны послужить им щитом, пока они не достигнут точки сбора.

content.original: Keep in mind that the convoy will try to stay near you for protection. Continue advancing to get them to the extract point!
content.prevOriginal: Keep in mind that the convoy will try to stay near you for protection. Continue advancing to get them to the extract point!
content.content: Имейте в виду, что конвой будет стараться оставаться рядом с вами для защиты. Продвигайтесь и вместе доберитесь до точки эвакуации.

content.original: And they are away! The convoy is safely out of the AO. Good work, Commander. Now get your remaining forces to the second evac zone for extraction there.
content.prevOriginal: And they are away! The convoy is safely out of the AO. Good work, Commander. Now get your remaining forces to the second evac zone for extraction there.
content.content: Ну вот и все! Конвой благополучно покинул зону операции. Хорошая работа, командир. Теперь направьте оставшиеся силы во вторую зону эвакуации, пора уходить отсюда.

content.original: Hostage Rescue
content.prevOriginal: Hostage Rescue
content.content: Спасение заложников

content.original: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} Medical DropShip ferrying casualties from a major offensive was attacked by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces and crippled.  It was forced to land behind enemy lines on [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]].  It appears crew and patients on board were taken captive by a heavily armed {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} force.  We don't have an available in-system military presence large enough to mount a hostage rescue mission, so we're looking for a competent mercenary company to do it. We need you to reach the facility where the crew is being held, destroy the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units guarding them, and escort them to safety.

content.original: We need to get to their location and secure the area so they can make their escape.

content.original: Expect serious resistance, now that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are alert for a rescue attempt.
content.prevOriginal: Expect serious resistance, now that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are alert for a rescue attempt.

content.original: The crew is safely back in orbit, Commander. Well done.
content.prevOriginal: The crew is safely back in orbit, Commander. Well done.
content.content: Экипаж благополучно вернулся на орбиту, командир. Отличная работа.

content.original: Dammit. That fell apart in a hurry. Let's debrief back in orbit, Commander.
content.prevOriginal: Dammit. That fell apart in a hurry. Let's debrief back in orbit, Commander.

content.original: Commander. The enemy has deployed reinforcements and they are inbound. Expect increased resistance.
content.prevOriginal: Commander. The enemy has deployed reinforcements and they are inbound. Expect increased resistance.
content.content: Командир. Противник вызвал подкрепление, и оно приближается. Ожидайте повышенное сопротивление.

content.original: More contacts on the sensors, Commander. They're moving to intercept the escaping hostages.
content.prevOriginal: More contacts on the sensors, Commander. They're moving to intercept the escaping hostages.
content.content: Еще больше контактов на сенсорах, командир. Они движутся на перехват бегущих заложников.

content.original: You've reached the extraction point for the objective vehicles. Hold there are keep them safe until we can get them out.
content.prevOriginal: You've reached the extraction point for the objective vehicles. Hold there are keep them safe until we can get them out.
content.content: Вы достигли точки эвакуации транспортных средств. Оставайтесь там и обеспечивайте их безопасность, пока мы не заберём их.

content.original: Looks like the crew has seized some light vehicles to make their escape. We'll need to run interference for them till they reach their pickup point.
content.prevOriginal: Looks like the crew has seized some light vehicles to make their escape. We'll need to run interference for them till they reach their pickup point.
content.content: Похоже, команда захватила несколько легких транспортных средств, чтобы совершить побег. Мы должны послужить им щитом, пока они не достигнут точки сбора.

content.original: Keep in mind that the convoy will try to stay near you for protection. Continue advancing to get them to the extract point!
content.prevOriginal: Keep in mind that the convoy will try to stay near you for protection. Continue advancing to get them to the extract point!
content.content: Имейте в виду, что конвой будет стараться оставаться рядом с вами для защиты. Продвигайтесь и вместе доберитесь до точки эвакуации.

content.original: And they are away! The convoy is safely out of the AO. Good work, Commander. Now get your remaining forces to the second evac zone for extraction there.
content.prevOriginal: And they are away! The convoy is safely out of the AO. Good work, Commander. Now get your remaining forces to the second evac zone for extraction there.
content.content: Ну вот и все! Конвой благополучно покинул зону операции. Хорошая работа, командир. Теперь направьте оставшиеся силы во вторую зону эвакуации, пора уходить отсюда.

content.original: Hostage Rescue
content.prevOriginal: Hostage Rescue
content.content: Спасение заложников

content.original: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} Medical DropShip ferrying casualties from a major offensive was attacked by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces and crippled.  It was forced to land behind enemy lines on [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]].  It appears crew and patients on board were taken captive by a heavily armed {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} force.  We don't have an available in-system military presence large enough to mount a hostage rescue mission, so we're looking for a competent mercenary company to do it. We need you to reach the facility where the crew is being held, destroy the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units guarding them, and escort them to safety.

content.content: Медицинский корабль {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}, перевозивший раненых во время крупного нападения, был атакован силами {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} и разбит. Он был вынужден приземлиться в тылу врага на [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]]. Похоже, что экипаж и пациенты на борту были взяты в плен хорошо вооруженными силами {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}. У нас нет достаточных военных сил в системе, чтобы организовать миссию по освобождению заложников, поэтому мы ищем компетентную компанию наёмников, которая сможет это сделать. Нам нужно, чтобы вы добрались до объекта, где удерживается экипаж, уничтожили охраняющие его силы {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} и сопроводили людей в безопасное место.

content.original: Assuming the hostages are still alive, we're going to have a hell of a time keeping them that way.  Our best defense is a good offense so we need to destroy anything that is even remotely a threat to the hostages.  Expect heavy resistance Commander.

content.content: Теперь ожидайте серьезное сопротивление, раз силы {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} оповещены о попытке спасения.

content.original: The crew is safely back in orbit, Commander. Well done.
content.prevOriginal: The crew is safely back in orbit, Commander. Well done.
content.content: Экипаж благополучно вернулся на орбиту, командир. Отличная работа.

content.original: Dammit. That fell apart in a hurry. Let's debrief back in orbit, Commander.
content.prevOriginal: Dammit. That fell apart in a hurry. Let's debrief back in orbit, Commander.
content.content: Проклятье. Как-то быстро всё развалилось. Давайте проведём разбор полётов на корабле, командир.

content.original: Commander. The enemy has deployed reinforcements and they are inbound. Expect increased resistance.
content.prevOriginal: Commander. The enemy has deployed reinforcements and they are inbound. Expect increased resistance.
content.content: Командир. Противник вызвал подкрепление, и оно приближается. Ожидайте повышенное сопротивление.

content.original: More contacts on the sensors, Commander. They're moving to intercept the escaping hostages.
content.prevOriginal: More contacts on the sensors, Commander. They're moving to intercept the escaping hostages.
content.content: Еще больше контактов на сенсорах, командир. Они движутся на перехват бегущих заложников.

content.original: You've reached the extraction point for the objective vehicles. Hold there are keep them safe until we can get them out.
content.prevOriginal: You've reached the extraction point for the objective vehicles. Hold there are keep them safe until we can get them out.
content.content: Вы достигли точки эвакуации транспортных средств. Оставайтесь там и обеспечивайте их безопасность, пока мы не заберём их.

content.original: Looks like the crew has seized some light vehicles to make their escape. We'll need to run interference for them till they reach their pickup point.
content.prevOriginal: Looks like the crew has seized some light vehicles to make their escape. We'll need to run interference for them till they reach their pickup point.
content.content: Похоже, команда захватила несколько легких транспортных средств, чтобы совершить побег. Мы должны послужить им щитом, пока они не достигнут точки сбора.

content.original: Keep in mind that the convoy will try to stay near you for protection. Continue advancing to get them to the extract point!
content.prevOriginal: Keep in mind that the convoy will try to stay near you for protection. Continue advancing to get them to the extract point!
content.content: Имейте в виду, что конвой будет стараться оставаться рядом с вами для защиты. Продвигайтесь и вместе доберитесь до точки эвакуации.

content.original: And they are away! The convoy is safely out of the AO. Good work, Commander. Now get your remaining forces to the second evac zone for extraction there.
content.prevOriginal: And they are away! The convoy is safely out of the AO. Good work, Commander. Now get your remaining forces to the second evac zone for extraction there.
content.content: Ну вот и все! Конвой благополучно покинул зону операции. Хорошая работа, командир. Теперь направьте оставшиеся силы во вторую зону эвакуации, пора уходить отсюда.

content.original: Hostage Rescue
content.prevOriginal: Hostage Rescue
content.content: Спасение заложников

content.original: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} Medical DropShip ferrying casualties from a major offensive was attacked by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces and crippled.  It was forced to land behind enemy lines on [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]].  It appears crew and patients on board were taken captive by a heavily armed {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} force.  We don't have an available in-system military presence large enough to mount a hostage rescue mission, so we're looking for a competent mercenary company to do it. We need you to reach the facility where the crew is being held, destroy the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units guarding them, and escort them to safety.
content.prevOriginal: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} Medical DropShip ferrying casualties from a major offensive was attacked by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces and crippled.  It was forced to land behind enemy lines on [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]].  It appears crew and patients on board were taken captive by a heavily armed {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} force.  We don't have an available in-system military presence large enough to mount a hostage rescue mission, so we're looking for a competent mercenary company to do it. We need you to reach the facility where the crew is being held, destroy the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units guarding them, and escort them to safety.
content.content: Медицинский корабль {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}, перевозивший раненых во время крупного нападения, был атакован силами {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} и разбит. Он был вынужден приземлиться в тылу врага на [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]]. Похоже, что экипаж и пациенты на борту были взяты в плен хорошо вооруженными силами {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}. У нас нет достаточных военных сил в системе, чтобы организовать миссию по освобождению заложников, поэтому мы ищем компетентную компанию наёмников, которая сможет это сделать. Нам нужно, чтобы вы добрались до объекта, где удерживается экипаж, уничтожили охраняющие его силы {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} и сопроводили людей в безопасное место.

content.original: Assuming the hostages are still alive, we're going to have a hell of a time keeping them that way.  Our best defense is a good offense so we need to destroy anything that is even remotely a threat to the hostages.  Expect heavy resistance Commander.
content.prevOriginal: Assuming the hostages are still alive, we're going to have a hell of a time keeping them that way.  Our best defense is a good offense so we need to destroy anything that is even remotely a threat to the hostages.  Expect heavy resistance Commander.
content.content: Если предположить, что заложники всё ещё живы, нам будет чертовски трудно не дать им погибнуть. Лучшая защита - это добротное нападение, поэтому нам нужно уничтожить всё, что хотя бы отдалённо представляет угрозу для заложников. Ожидайте сильное сопротивление, командир.

content.original: EyeSpy Electronics need you to recover our proprietary data schematics from inside a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} backed research facility. This rival company acquired them from a former employee, and we need to get that data back. Our operative in the area has disabled their firewall so we can retrieve the schematics digitally and destroy any duplicates at the same time. This data is highly sensitive so any tampering or attempts to copy or record it will void your contract and have both legal and financial repercussions.

content.original: We've discovered that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} has been operating out of a decommissioned manufacturing facility in this region. We were unable to locate the facility until your intel alerted us.  An undercover agent working for {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} had marked that facility as completely destroyed in an earthquake, so no one ever bothered to investigate it.  {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} needs to capture this facility. You'll make a surgical strike, occupy the base, and hold it until {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces can arrive to take control.

Агент под прикрытием, работающий на {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}, пометил этот объект как полностью разрушенный во время землетрясения, поэтому никто не удосужился его исследовать. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} хочет захватить его. Вам предстоит нанести хирургический удар, захватить базу и удерживать её до тех пор, пока силы {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} не прибудут, чтобы взять её под контроль.

content.original: Increased pirate activity around {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} points at a possible intelligence gathering operation. We believe there's an undiscovered {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} outpost here on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} doing exactly that. Monitoring the pattern of DropShips making landings on the planet has led {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} analysts to a remote area and your recent scans have allowed us to triangulate their location. That facility isn't empty, and we want the data stored there.

Этот объект не пустует, и нам нужны хранящиеся там данные.

content.original: One of our DropShips was in the {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} system when it experienced engine problems. A final message indicated a hard landing. That DropShip was carrying a valuable piece of technology as cargo, and while the ship itself can be replaced, we very much need to recover the cargo it was carrying. Satellite imagery suggests that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces recovered the cargo and are holding it at a nearby facility. We need you to raid that facility and recover the item.  We will even toss in a bonus crate for your assistance.

Этот корабль перевозил ценный технологический груз, и хотя сам корабль заменяем, нам очень нужно вернуть груз, который он перевозил. За вашу помощь мы даже добавим к оплате 1 бонусный ящик.

content.original: We have an opportunity to get our hands on the next season of a popular holovid series before it's sent out for general distribution. Fans will pay through the nose to get a copy even a few weeks early. All you have to do is go to the secure {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} facility where the data is being stored, and our agent will transmit the data directly to your 'Mech. Oh, if you have a chance, pick the agent up, too? He's holed up in a secondary facility.  He's also bringing some tech we'll share if you are successful.

content.content: У нас есть возможность заполучить следующий сезон популярного головидеосериала до того, как он поступит в общую продажу. Фанаты будут платить нам за то, чтобы получить копию на несколько недель раньше срока. Всё, что вам нужно сделать, - это отправиться на охраняемый объект {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}, где хранятся записи, и наш агент удалённо перешлёт их прямо в ваш мех. Ах да, если будет возможность, то заберите и самого агента. Он заперт в соседнем здании. У него также есть несколько крутых штук, которыми мы поделимся, если вы добьетесь успеха.

content.original:
Sender: MRB Representative of {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}
Recipient: Commander {COMMANDER.LastName} of Mercenary Outfit {COMPANY.CompanyName}
Subject: Available Contract


Primary Objective: The primary objective of this contract is to undertake a rescue operation to retrieve a high-value target (VIP) who has been unlawfully detained as a hostage by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces.

Secondary Objective: The secondary objective entails the retrieval of a briefcase known to have be in the possession of the VIP, which contains highly classified information crucial to our client's interests.

Mission Details: The Mercenary Outfit is to deploy a specialized team comprising of skilled MechWarriors, tacticians, and support personnel for the execution of the rescue mission. The team must infiltrate the enemy-held territory, locate the VIP's whereabouts, and execute a swift and decisive extraction, prioritizing the safety and survival of the VIP over the retrieval of the briefcase.

Threat Assessment: The target location is anticipated to be heavily fortified, requiring the deployment of advanced combat strategies and tactics. Intelligence suggests the presence of active enemy patrols and potentially several superheavy units. The Mercenary Outfit must be prepared for both conventional and asymmetrical threats.

Rules of Engagement: The Mercenary Outfit is authorized to utilize all necessary means to achieve the mission objectives, including but not limited to, armed engagement, stealth tactics, and diplomatic negotiations where applicable. Preservation of the VIP's life is of utmost priority, with the retrieval of the briefcase considered a secondary objective.

Timeline: The contract specifies a strict timeline for the completion of the rescue operation. The Mercenary Outfit must execute the mission within the designated timeframe to ensure the safety and timely extraction of the VIP, with efforts made to retrieve the briefcase only if feasible within the operational parameters.

Compensation: Upon successful completion of the main objective, the Mercenary Outfit will be entitled to a pre-negotiated financial and salvage share compensation, including bonuses for exceptional performance and adherence to mission parameters. Additional compensation may be provided for the fulfillment of the secondary objective, subject to the discretion of the client.

Confidentiality: All aspects of this contract, including mission details, client identity, and operational information, are classified as confidential. The Mercenary Outfit must exercise discretion and maintain strict confidentiality throughout the duration of the contract.

Contract Terms: The terms of this contract are legally binding and are subject to negotiation and agreement between the client and the Mercenary Outfit. Any deviations from the agreed-upon terms must be documented and mutually approved in writing by both parties.


Client Authorization Code: [MRB-SC-4876-936-5618-D]

content.content:
Отправитель: Представитель MRB от {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}
Получатель: Командир {COMMANDER.LastName} подразделения наёмников {COMPANY.CompanyName}
Тема: Возможный контракт


Основная цель: Основная цель этого контракта — провести спасательную операцию по освобождению особо ценной цели (VIP), которая была незаконно задержана в качестве заложника силами {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}.

Второстепенная цель: Второстепенная цель заключается в заполучении портфеля, который, насколько известно, находится у VIP, и который содержит строго секретную информацию, имеющую решающее значение для интересов нашего клиента.

Детали миссии: Отряд наёмников должен направить спецгруппу, состоящую из опытных мехвоинов, тактиков и вспомогательного персонала для выполнения спасательной миссии. Команда должна проникнуть на территорию, удерживаемую противником, определить местонахождение VIP и выполнить быструю и решительную эвакуацию, отдавая приоритет безопасности и выживанию VIP.

Оценка угрозы: Ожидается, что зона операции будет сильно укреплена, поэтому требуется разработка наилучшей боевой стратегии и тактики. Разведка предполагает наличие активных вражеских патрулей и потенциально нескольких сверхтяжелых юнитов.

Правила ведения боевых действий: Наёмники уполномочены использовать все необходимые средства для достижения целей миссии, включая, помимо прочего, вооруженное столкновение, скрытную тактику и дипломатические переговоры, если применимо. Сохранение жизни VIP-персоны является первостепенной задачей, а возвращение портфеля считается второстепенной задачей.

Сроки: В контракте указаны строгие временные рамки спасательной операции. Наёмники должны выполнить миссию в установленные сроки, чтобы обеспечить безопасность и своевременное извлечение VIP, при этом усилия по извлечению портфеля должны быть предприняты только в том случае, если это осуществимо в рамках параметров операции.

Компенсация: После успешного выполнения основной задачи наёмники будут иметь право на заранее оговоренную финансовую и трофейную долю компенсации, включая бонусы за исключительное исполнение и соблюдение параметров миссии. Дополнительная компенсация может быть предоставлена ​​за выполнение второстепенной задачи по усмотрению клиента.

Конфиденциальность: Все аспекты этого контракта, включая детали миссии, личность клиента и оперативная информация, классифицируются как конфиденциальные. Наёмное подразделение должно проявлять осмотрительность и сохранять строгую конфиденциальность на протяжении всего срока действия контракта.

Условия контракта: Условия этого контракта являются юридически обязательными и подлежат обсуждению и соглашению между клиентом и наёмным подразделением. Любые отклонения от согласованных условий должны быть задокументированы и взаимно одобрены в письменной форме обеими сторонами.

content.content: БЕСПОЛЕЗНАЯ ЗАДАЧА

content.original: I'm getting radio chatter from the facility, Commander. It sounds like the crew has staged an uprising.
content.prevOriginal: I'm getting radio chatter from the facility, Commander. It sounds like the crew has staged an uprising.
content.content: Я получаю радиопереговоры с объекта, командир. Похоже, что персонал поднял восстание.

content.original: We need to get to their location and secure the area so they can make their escape.
content.prevOriginal: We need to get to their location and secure the area so they can make their escape.
content.content: Мы должны добраться до их местонахождения и оцепить территорию, чтобы они могли сбежать.

content.original: Expect serious resistance, now that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are alert for a rescue attempt.
content.prevOriginal: Expect serious resistance, now that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are alert for a rescue attempt.
content.content: Теперь ожидайте серьезное сопротивление, раз силы {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} оповещены о попытке спасения.

content.original: The crew is safely back in orbit, Commander. Well done.
content.prevOriginal: The crew is safely back in orbit, Commander. Well done.
content.content: Экипаж благополучно вернулся на орбиту, командир. Отличная работа.

content.original: Dammit. That fell apart in a hurry. Let's debrief back in orbit, Commander.
content.prevOriginal: Dammit. That fell apart in a hurry. Let's debrief back in orbit, Commander.
content.content: Проклятье. Как-то быстро всё развалилось. Давайте проведём разбор полётов на корабле, командир.

content.original: Commander. The enemy has deployed reinforcements and they are inbound. Expect increased resistance.
content.prevOriginal: Commander. The enemy has deployed reinforcements and they are inbound. Expect increased resistance.
content.content: Командир. Противник вызвал подкрепление, и оно приближается. Ожидайте повышенное сопротивление.

content.original: More contacts on the sensors, Commander. They're moving to intercept the escaping hostages.
content.prevOriginal: More contacts on the sensors, Commander. They're moving to intercept the escaping hostages.
content.content: Еще больше контактов на сенсорах, командир. Они движутся на перехват бегущих заложников.

content.original: You've reached the extraction point for the objective vehicles. Hold there are keep them safe until we can get them out.
content.prevOriginal: You've reached the extraction point for the objective vehicles. Hold there are keep them safe until we can get them out.
content.content: Вы достигли точки эвакуации транспортных средств. Оставайтесь там и обеспечивайте их безопасность, пока мы не заберём их.

content.original: Looks like the crew has seized some light vehicles to make their escape. We'll need to run interference for them till they reach their pickup point.
content.prevOriginal: Looks like the crew has seized some light vehicles to make their escape. We'll need to run interference for them till they reach their pickup point.
content.content: Похоже, команда захватила несколько легких транспортных средств, чтобы совершить побег. Мы должны послужить им щитом, пока они не достигнут точки сбора.

content.original: Keep in mind that the convoy will try to stay near you for protection. Continue advancing to get them to the extract point!
content.prevOriginal: Keep in mind that the convoy will try to stay near you for protection. Continue advancing to get them to the extract point!
content.content: Имейте в виду, что конвой будет стараться оставаться рядом с вами для защиты. Продвигайтесь и вместе доберитесь до точки эвакуации.

content.original: And they are away! The convoy is safely out of the AO. Good work, Commander. Now get your remaining forces to the second evac zone for extraction there.
content.prevOriginal: And they are away! The convoy is safely out of the AO. Good work, Commander. Now get your remaining forces to the second evac zone for extraction there.
content.content: Ну вот и все! Конвой благополучно покинул зону операции. Хорошая работа, командир. Теперь направьте оставшиеся силы во вторую зону эвакуации, пора уходить отсюда.

content.original: Hostage Rescue
content.prevOriginal: Hostage Rescue
content.content: Спасение заложников

content.original: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} Medical DropShip ferrying casualties from a major offensive was attacked by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces and crippled.  It was forced to land behind enemy lines on [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]].  It appears crew and patients on board were taken captive by a heavily armed {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} force.  We don't have an available in-system military presence large enough to mount a hostage rescue mission, so we're looking for a competent mercenary company to do it. We need you to reach the facility where the crew is being held, destroy the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units guarding them, and escort them to safety.
content.prevOriginal: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} Medical DropShip ferrying casualties from a major offensive was attacked by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces and crippled.  It was forced to land behind enemy lines on [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]].  It appears crew and patients on board were taken captive by a heavily armed {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} force.  We don't have an available in-system military presence large enough to mount a hostage rescue mission, so we're looking for a competent mercenary company to do it. We need you to reach the facility where the crew is being held, destroy the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units guarding them, and escort them to safety.
content.content: Медицинский корабль {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}, перевозивший раненых во время крупного нападения, был атакован силами {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} и разбит. Он был вынужден приземлиться в тылу врага на [[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]]. Похоже, что экипаж и пациенты на борту были взяты в плен хорошо вооруженными силами {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}. У нас нет достаточных военных сил в системе, чтобы организовать миссию по освобождению заложников, поэтому мы ищем компетентную компанию наёмников, которая сможет это сделать. Нам нужно, чтобы вы добрались до объекта, где удерживается экипаж, уничтожили охраняющие его силы {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} и сопроводили людей в безопасное место.

content.original: Assuming the hostages are still alive, we're going to have a hell of a time keeping them that way.  Our best defense is a good offense so we need to destroy anything that is even remotely a threat to the hostages.  Expect heavy resistance Commander.
content.prevOriginal: Assuming the hostages are still alive, we're going to have a hell of a time keeping them that way.  Our best defense is a good offense so we need to destroy anything that is even remotely a threat to the hostages.  Expect heavy resistance Commander.
content.content: Если предположить, что заложники всё ещё живы, нам будет чертовски трудно не дать им погибнуть. Лучшая защита - это добротное нападение, поэтому нам нужно уничтожить всё, что хотя бы отдалённо представляет угрозу для заложников. Ожидайте сильное сопротивление, командир.

content.original: A disused industrial plant on Custozza has been flagged as a potential source of the advanced BattleMech modifications uncovered on Maisons. Though officially abandoned for decades, recent forensic evidence suggests someone has quietly and deliberately reactivated the facility. Star Colonel Arelle Jorgensson has ordered your unit to deploy, secure the site, and eliminate any resistance. Your objective is to capture the facility intact for Ghost Bear analysis. Intelligence support is minimal, and any hostiles present are unlikely to surrender peacefully. Expect improvised defenses, internal resistance, and the possibility that the facility's current occupants are far more prepared than they appear.

content.original:
Commander {COMMANDER.Callsign}.

This operation is not optional. You will proceed as instructed.

Reconnaissance over Maisons identified a battlefield where an unknown force eradicated a pirate band with surgical precision. The site has since been sanitized, clearly an attempt to remove all traces.

One item remains: a BattleMech arm, partially buried and overlooked. Spectral analysis confirms residual energy patterns consistent with the anomalous units encountered during your prior engagement. Units that remain unidentified and unclaimed by any known faction. That fragment is now your objective.

The surviving pirates are searching for it as well. Intelligence suggests they believe the arm may reveal the identity of their attackers, information they intend to use for retaliation. You are to intercept them. Do not allow recovery or transmission of any data.

You have seven days to begin this mission. After that, the evidence will be lost. Retrieved, destroyed, or buried beyond reach.

Salvage is yours. Compensation will be minimal. This assignment serves as a test of your competence and reliability.

Complete it, or do not expect further contact.

- Star Colonel Arelle Jorgensson
Ghost Bear Watch, Theta-Level Command

content.original: Long-range sensors have detected a formation of BattleMechs moving through the remote terrain of Melidron. Their formation pattern, thermal profiles, and signal behavior match those of the advanced modified designs first observed during earlier encounters. Machines believed to be connected to the long since Annihilated Clan Wolverine. These are not relics. These are active combat units. Modernized, field-tested, and hidden behind silence. Engagement is authorized. The objective is not complete destruction, but recovery of data, wreckage, or any identifying components. Transmission must be prevented at all costs. If these units withdraw intact, another chance may not come again. They have erased their history and masked their movements. But now, the updated Wolverine-born designs have been seen in the open. They must be forced to leave something behind.

content.original: Deep in the humid lowlands of Horgens III, the Minnesota Tribe is running a high-value convoy through a network of old aquaculture roads and jungle trails. The planet's minimal colonial development and dense canopy provide natural cover, perfect for moving critical supplies like fusion cells, munitions, and food to their inland forward depot. You are to strike mid-route. The convoy is already en route and under escort. Hit them while they're exposed. Your mission is to destroy all transport vehicles before they can escape to the extraction zone. Expect coordinated resistance from escorts and potential reinforcements responding to the ambush. Failure to stop the shipment will allow the Tribe to continue reinforcing their forward position on Horgens III, endangering further Ghost Bear operations in the system.

That facility contained experimental ECM prototypes designed to function under intense atmospheric interference, specifically calibrated for the electromagnetic storm conditions on this world. Now the Tribe is attempting to extract those systems off-world. Intelligence assets have flagged a mobile convoy of medium vehicles and escort 'Mechs transporting the stolen hardware toward a remote launch point. You are to intercept and destroy the convoy before it reaches orbit. If this technology is recovered, the Tribe could mask future operations from standard monitoring protocols. This cannot be allowed.

content.original: Intelligence suggests the Minnesota Tribe has activated a prototype war machine codenamed Armageddon. Recon data is scarce. Drone telemetry is unreliable, and the area around the last power surge detection is heavily distorted. Your objective is simple: find and eliminate the prototype before it can leave Fröislandis VII. Watch operatives believe it is mobile, heavily armored, and possesses devastating firepower. This is a kill mission. There is no base to raid, no convoy to intercept. Just a ghost in the snow and the end of a long chase. You're not authorized to retreat unless the target is destroyed. The fate of this war may hinge on your success.

content.original: Intelligence recovered from intercepted Tribe communications has confirmed the presence of Red Snow, the elusive tactical commander responsible for orchestrating the Tribe's precision strikes across multiple regions. His command style is decentralized but surgical. He has been the architect behind most of their recent raids, including the vault incursion. According to Ghost Bear Watch analysis, Red Snow is personally overseeing the fallback operation following the failed assault on Dunianshire VI. He's expected to maintain position at a forward logistics post to monitor retreat routes, with a dedicated escort detail. This is a rare opportunity. Eliminating Red Snow will degrade the Tribe's ability to coordinate rapid strike operations and may expose the broader structure behind their strategic planning. Expect fallback paths, mobile escorts, and the possibility of withdrawal maneuvers. If the target attempts escape, stop him at all costs.

content.original: Warden Thalos Rooke, the shadowy administrator of Butzfleth's mega-prison, has been covertly supplying the Minnesota Tribe with indentured labor, drawn directly from his inmate population. These forced workers are being used to construct defensive redoubts, supply depots, and even sub-surface bunkers across contested systems. Ghost Bear Watch assets have traced encrypted transmissions and unlogged prisoner transfers directly to Rooke's command. He is personally overseeing the arrangement from a secure operational site beneath the prison's east wing, flanked by private security and hand-picked loyalists. Eliminate Warden Rooke. Make it clean. No survivors, nothing that can trace back to us.

content.original: Ghost Bear scouts have identified a newly established Minnesota Tribe field command node on Horgens III. The facility coordinates operations across the system, managing logistics, relaying orders, and maintaining battlefield cohesion. It is not yet fully operational. Your mission is to strike now, while the base is still under construction. Automated turret systems remain offline, and defensive coverage is incomplete. Capture all strategic positions within the compound and eliminate resistance. Expect the Tribe to deploy combat engineers during the engagement in a last-ditch effort to activate defensive systems mid-battle. Securing this command node will fracture the Tribe's ability to coordinate regionally and unravel their remaining offensive momentum on Horgens III.

This facility is sparsely manned but equipped with hardened systems, pre-fab barracks, and reinforced storage bays. Ghost Bear Command has designated it a high-priority capture objective. content.original: A hidden [[DM.Factions[faction_SLDF],SLDF]] vault on Dunianshire VI has become the next target of the Minnesota Tribe's deep strike campaign. Though officially dormant, the site remains under sealed protection. Guarded, maintained, and curiously off the books. Whatever lies within, rumors suggest it's tied to a classified research program with wide-ranging implications for heavy industry and weapons development. The vault is located far from major settlements and sensor coverage. Local [[TGT_SYSTEM.OwnerDef,{TGT_SYSTEM.OwnerDef.Demonym}]] authorities are unlikely to even be aware of the attack until it's over. There will be no reinforcements. No oversight. Ghost Bear Watch has rerouted you to intercept the incoming strike team. Majesty's on-site defense units are few and outmatched. This defense is on you. The Tribe moves with surgical precision: expect a quick, brutal assault designed to breach, extract, and vanish without a trace. Do not let them succeed.

content.original: A recently discovered mine on Kuras Drift is the source of the dense, unidentified alloy transported in the intercepted convoy. The mine is operated by the Minnesota Tribe and appears to have been adapted for deep subsurface extraction. Due to the depth, a full collapse is unfeasible. However, the surface-level infrastructure includes atmospheric processors and environmental shielding vital for safe operation. Ghost Bear Watch analysts believe that destroying the facility's outer structures will make the mine inoperable. With no functional atmospheric support, the Tribe will be forced to abandon the site. Expect reinforced perimeter security and automated defenses.

content.original: The Minnesota Tribe has reactivated a Star League-era terraforming uplink embedded deep in an abandoned cliffside facility near Eagle Rest II's equatorial coast. Ghost Bear Watch analysis confirms the site is no longer performing atmospheric regulation. It has been modified into a low-frequency command relay, capable of transmitting encrypted signals across multiple systems without triggering standard monitoring protocols. This array is likely supporting long-range logistics, unit coordination, or off-site supply networks hidden beyond known space. You are to destroy the uplink and all associated infrastructure. Recovery of any remains is strictly forbidden. Time is critical. If the Tribe has fallback systems linked to this relay, they'll activate them the moment the array begins to fail. Expect defenders.
