content.original: A Minnesota Tribe combat training range has been flagged by Watch recon as a soft target of opportunity. Located within the rust-red wastes of Carath Prime, a low-atmosphere world once used by the [[DM.Factions[faction_RimWorldsRepublic],Rim Worlds Republic]] for military exercises. The range is currently hosting a cadre of cadets in live-fire training. While the cadets are inexperienced, Watch intelligence confirms that senior instructors frequently oversee operations on-site. These veterans pose a serious threat, but current surveillance suggests they are not in the area at this time, making now the optimal moment to strike. The facility holds no long-term value and is not fortified. Your objective is simple. Destroy the on-site defenders, inflict maximum casualties, and disrupt the Tribe's leadership pipeline before these trainees return to the front. Expect improvised tactics and escalating resistance. Reinforcements may arrive if the instructors rally for a counterattack.

content.original:
Intelligence confirms a [[TGT_SYSTEM.OwnerDef,{TGT_SYSTEM.OwnerDef.Demonym}]] convoy operating under [[DM.Factions[faction_GhostBearWatch],Ghost Bear Watch]] coordination is transporting bio-warfare research materials through the frontier region. Analysis indicates these shipments are disguised as medical supplies but contain weaponized pathogen samples intended for deployment against [[DM.Factions[faction_MinnesotaTribe],Tribe]] civilian populations in the Periphery.

The convoy is scheduled to transit through a narrow canyon pass within the next week. This terrain provides ideal ambush conditions with limited escape routes and overlapping fields of fire from elevated positions. Your objective is complete destruction of all convoy vehicles and their cargo before they reach the destination settlements.

Expected opposition includes at least one full lance of escort mechs and a group of heavy transport vehicles carrying the bio-warfare materials. Intelligence suggests the escort is operating under strict orders to protect the cargo at all costs. They will not abandon the transports.

Complete elimination of all convoy elements is required. We cannot risk these weaponized pathogens reaching populated areas. No cargo can be allowed to escape the engagement zone.

content.original:
Intelligence has identified a [[DM.Factions[faction_GhostBearWatch],Ghost Bear Watch]] forward surveillance post operating in an isolated region of St. Andreas. The facility has been coordinating intelligence gathering on [[DM.Factions[faction_MinnesotaTribe],Minnesota Tribe]] cell locations across the sector, feeding targeting data to Watch strike teams conducting operations against Tribe assets.

Reconnaissance shows heavy fortifications protecting the installation, including advanced turret emplacements and multiple lances of frontline combat units deployed in defensive positions. This level of military protection confirms the facility's high intelligence value to Watch command and suggests it may house critical surveillance infrastructure.

Recent garrison rotation cycles have created a narrow operational window for assault. Primary objective is to capture the facility intact and extract all intelligence data from the central servers before Watch command can initiate remote purge protocols. Secondary objective is to secure any physical intelligence materials present at the site.

Expected opposition includes heavy garrison forces with fortified defensive positions. content.original: The Minnesota Tribe's newly established field command node on Horgens III has been identified by Ghost Bear scouts. Intelligence confirms an imminent full-force assault aimed at crippling the command infrastructure and severing strategic coordination for the region. The site is still under rapid construction, with incomplete defenses and inactive turret emplacements. Combat engineers will be deployed during the battle to bring automated systems online, but they must be protected while doing so. Holding the command center is essential. Its loss would compromise communications, logistics, and tactical cohesion across multiple operations in the sector, potentially reversing Tribe gains throughout the Horgens theater.

content.original: The former [[DM.Factions[faction_RemembranceCell],Remembrance Cell]] primary research facility on Argondale contains the complete documentation archive of the Armageddon project. Dr. Tilsaye requires direct physical access to the archive terminal to extract the records, as remote access has been deliberately disabled by security protocols. The download process cannot be accelerated without risking data corruption and will require approximately forty minutes of sustained connection time. The local Remembrance Cell forces under Joanna McEvedy's command will respond immediately once their sensors detect activity at the facility location. Primary objective is to defend the facility perimeter and prevent enemy forces from reaching Dr. Tilsaye until the archive extraction is complete. Expected opposition includes heavy assault forces with orders to destroy the archive and eliminate Dr. Tilsaye before she can secure the evidence. The archive contains comprehensive documentation of the Armageddon project from initial conception through current assembly status. If this evidence is lost or destroyed, there will be no independent verification of the project's existence or capabilities beyond witness testimony.

content.original: The Armageddon production facility stands before you. Inside, Joanna McEvedy has deployed [[DM.Factions[faction_RemembranceCell],Remembrance Cell's]] prototype superheavy weapons platform along with every remaining warrior loyal to her vision. This is her final stand, this is where the weapon either is destroyed or destroys everyone else. Primary objectives are threefold. First, eliminate Joanna McEvedy herself to ensure she cannot rebuild or continue this project. Second, destroy the Armageddon prototype before it can be used or its technology recovered. Third, demolish the production facility to erase all physical evidence of its construction methods and technical specifications. Your forces are already damaged from breaching the perimeter defenses. Environmental conditions on Fröislandis VII continue to degrade combat effectiveness. Joanna will deploy the Armageddon prototype in combat defense of the facility. This superheavy mech exceeds all known design limitations and incorporates unknown weapon systems designated Project Rotating Fury. Expect capabilities beyond standard combat parameters. Remaining Remembrance Cell forces represent the most fanatical believers in Joanna's ideology. They view this weapon as their people's only guarantee of survival and will defend it with suicidal determination. They know what failure means. So do you. Failure results in immediate nuclear detonation. Marcus Hammerick has a two hundred gigaton warhead prepared for deployment if the facility cannot be secured. Everyone on Fröislandis VII dies if you fail. Win or die, there can be no other outcomes.

content.original: Intelligence reports confirm the presence of Research Station Theta-7 on Ryerson, a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} archival facility containing historical records and intelligence assessments related to Clan Wolverine operations. According to our sources, the facility houses classified documentation that could be weaponized against our people if it would become accessible to the Clans. Your objective is to penetrate the facility's defensive perimeter, eliminate garrison forces, and ensure complete destruction of the data storage infrastructure. Primary targets include the main server vault, backup power systems, and offsite relay nodes. Secondary destruction of physical archives is required to prevent manual recovery. Expected opposition includes a reinforced garrison lance and automated turret defenses. The facility's remote location provides operational security, but response forces from the regional capital could arrive within hours of alarm activation. Timing is critical. Complete destruction must be verified before extraction.

content.original: A [[DM.Factions[faction_GhostBearWatch],Ghost Bear Watch]] detention facility in the St. Andreas system holds [[DM.Factions[faction_MinnesotaTribe],Minnesota Tribe]] operatives captured during recent Periphery operations. Intelligence confirms two confirmed Tribe personnel currently imprisoned, awaiting trial and likely execution under Ghost Bear counter-terrorism protocols. The facility has classified these operatives as 'terrorists and war criminals' under Ghost Bear legal jurisdiction. Ghost Bear Watch maintains documented practices of enhanced interrogation before carrying out sentences. These individuals have been held for months and are likely to have been interrogated many times, leading to immediate need for rescue. In addition to confirmed Tribe operatives, intelligence has identified three prisoners flagged as affiliated to our cause based on intercepted communications and detention records. These individuals represent potential sympathizers who face similar execution risk once Ghost Bear Watch completes interrogation protocols. Mission parameters require breach of the detention facility, location of all prisoners marked on the extraction manifest, and evacuation before Ghost Bear command can execute sentences. Expected heavy opposition, The facility is hardened against rescue attempts with overlapping defensive positions and at least three lances of garrison units.

Assess terrain viability for future Tribe expansion and retrieve key schematics from a remote data relay. Their last transmission confirmed contact with Ghost Bear Watch forces before cutting out. Sensor triangulation has narrowed down their likely position. It is believed they are still alive and evading capture. The unit must locate the scout team, secure their data package, and extract them safely before Watch troops close in. Failure to recover the scouts would mean the loss of valuable intelligence concerning the Tribe's forward command infrastructure on Horgens.

content.original: Beneath the worn ruins of Rim Worlds Republic Outpost #11, Tribe engineers have uncovered a buried SLDF research site. Among the wreckage are fragments of a long-lost training simulator program and advanced testing equipment, remnants of an experimental combat doctrine initiative. Ghost Bear Watch scouts have already detected activity near the site and are closing in. If recovered, these relics could provide valuable insight into Star League-era tactical thinking and even bolster the Tribe's current training protocols. Your mission is to reach the site, secure and extract the surviving artifacts, and ensure the enemy cannot destroy or seize them. Expect opposition and potential reinforcement waves once the operation begins.

The objective is solely the removal of armed opposition. Exercise precision and avoid unnecessary collateral damage.

content.original: [[DM.Factions[faction_RemembranceCell],Remembrance Cell]] perimeter forces have established defensive positions around the Armageddon facility on [[DM.StarSystems[starsystemdef_Fröislandis],Fröislandis VII]]. These are Joanna McEvedy's most fanatical warriors, deployed to protect what they believe is their people's only guarantee of survival. They know the terrain, they know what they're defending, and they will fight to the death. Primary objective is complete elimination of all perimeter defenders. No enemy forces can be allowed to remain operational. Once these defenses fall, immediate assault on the inner facility will commence without pause for repairs or resupply. Environmental conditions are extreme. Fröislandis VII is a frozen planet covered in polar ice caps and tundra biomes. Temperatures are well below zero, visibility is limited by constant snowfall, and atmospheric interference degrades sensor performance. Heat dissipation will be excellent but mobility and targeting systems will be compromised. This is a continuous operation. The moment perimeter defenses are breached, Phase Two assault on the production facility begins. There is no time to withdraw, regroup, or repair damaged units. Failure is not survivable. If perimeter defenders are not eliminated and the facility cannot be secured, Star Captain Marcus Hammerick will deploy the doomsday device. Complete destruction of all hostile forces is required.

With them still inexperienced, they will begin an immediate withdrawal. The facility itself holds no strategic value and can be replaced if lost. Expect moderate resistance with potential for reinforcements. Success will help preserve the Tribe's next generation of leaders and diminish Watch operational reach in the region.

content.original: Commander {COMMANDER.Callsign}, A target of interest is currently moving through a low-traffic sector under minimal escort. This presents a rare window to eliminate it before it reaches secure territory. Your mission is to intercept and destroy the convoy. Swiftly, quietly, and without attracting unnecessary attention. Be advised: rapid-response forces are stationed nearby. A drop too large will trigger an immediate alarm. This operation demands precision. Deploy only a small, fast strike group, neutralize the targets, and extract before reinforcements mobilize. There will be no questions, no debrief, and no salvage rights. None. Compensation will be delivered via direct C-bill transfer outside standard MRBC channels. You will receive three million c-bills total, a sum that includes a significant bonus in return for your discretion in not reporting this operation through official channels. This is a closed-loop assignment. Accept. Execute. Move on. -Mizuki Bekker Contract Restrictions: Maximum of 4 units and 280 total tons. No individual unit may exceed 70 tons.

content.original: I'm having a great day, Commander. You know why? I just got the latest logistics data from our friends down on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. Turns out that the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} base where they keep all the stuff they're planning to ship off planet? It's going to be full of some extremely valuable cargo and hopefully a even a mech. Things we'd like to get our hands on. You capture the base, we'll loot it, and we'll both get paid.
content.prevOriginal: I'm having a great day, Commander. You know why? I just got the latest logistics data from our friends down on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. content.content: У меня выдался отличный день, командир. Знаешь почему? Только что получил свежие логистические данные от наших друзей с {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. Оказывается, на базе {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}, где они складируют всё, что собираются вывезти с планеты, полно ценнейшего груза — возможно, даже мех найдётся. Нам такое пригодится. Ты захватываешь базу, мы её обчищаем — и оба остаёмся в плюсе.

content.original: I don't like the unspecified 'some cargo', Commander, but whatever it is, it's probably just as bad if left in {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} hands.

content.prevOriginal: Ripe for the Picking

content.original: I'm having a great day, Commander. You know why? I just got the latest logistics data from our friends down on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. Turns out that the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} base where they keep all the stuff they're planning to ship off planet? It's going to be full of some extremely valuable cargo and hopefully a even a mech. Things we'd like to get our hands on. You capture the base, we'll loot it, and we'll both get paid.

Оказывается, на базе {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}, где они складируют всё, что собираются вывезти с планеты, полно ценнейшего груза — возможно, даже мех найдётся. Нам такое пригодится. Ты захватываешь базу, мы её обчищаем — и оба остаёмся в плюсе.

It's going to be full of some extremely valuable cargo and hopefully a even a mech. Things we'd like to get our hands on. You capture the base, we'll loot it, and we'll both get paid.

Оказывается, на базе {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}, где они складируют всё, что собираются вывезти с планеты, полно ценнейшего груза — возможно, даже мех найдётся. Нам такое пригодится. Ты захватываешь базу, мы её обчищаем — и оба остаёмся в плюсе.

content.original: I'm having a great day, Commander. You know why? I just got the latest logistics data from our friends down on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. Turns out that the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} base where they keep all the stuff they're planning to ship off planet? It's going to be full of some extremely valuable cargo and hopefully a even a mech. Things we'd like to get our hands on. You capture the base, we'll loot it, and we'll both get paid.
content.prevOriginal: I'm having a great day, Commander. You know why? I just got the latest logistics data from our friends down on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. Turns out that the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} base where they keep all the stuff they're planning to ship off planet? It's going to be full of some extremely valuable cargo and hopefully a even a mech. Things we'd like to get our hands on. You capture the base, we'll loot it, and we'll both get paid.
content.content: У меня выдался отличный день, командир. Знаешь почему? Только что получил свежие логистические данные от наших друзей с {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. Оказывается, на базе {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}, где они складируют всё, что собираются вывезти с планеты, полно ценнейшего груза — возможно, даже мех найдётся. Нам такое пригодится. Ты захватываешь базу, мы её обчищаем — и оба остаёмся в плюсе.

content.original: I don't like the unspecified 'some cargo', Commander, but whatever it is, it's probably just as bad if left in {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} hands.
